- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```csharp
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>
    /// TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 2, the owner's complaint as a test: a slow camera pan over
    /// thin geometry flickers less than MSAA 4x by the grass probe's flip metric. Plus review focus 2 (the default
    /// isometric camera zooming does not swim) and review focus 4 (a prop mid-fade converges to a steady partial
    /// coverage and flickers less than MSAA 4x under the same pan).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalStabilityGoldenTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180, Warm = 16, Measured = 64;
        const float PanPixelsPerFrame = 0.2f;

        // Acceptance thresholds, first estimates the first real-Metal run retunes in one place.
        const double MinMsaaFlipRate = 0.005;                        // MSAA 4x has to flicker or the comparison is empty
        const double MinHeldCoverage = 0.3, MaxHeldCoverage = 0.7;   // a half dissolve's converged coverage
        const double MaxHeldFlipRate = 0.01;                         // flips per pixel per frame of a held dissolve

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalStabilityGoldenTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        void AssertCalmer(string what, double msaa, double taa)
        {
            string ctx = $"{what}: flips per pixel per frame, MSAA 4x {msaa:0.0000}, TAA {taa:0.0000}";
            _out.WriteLine(ctx);
            Assert.True(msaa >= MinMsaaFlipRate, $"MSAA 4x must flicker on this path or the comparison measures nothing. {ctx}");
            Assert.True(taa < msaa, $"temporal anti-aliasing must flicker less than MSAA 4x. {ctx}");
        }

        double FenceFlips(AntiAliasing aa, TemporalUpscale preset)
        {
            var fence = new FenceScene(W, H);
            return TemporalAcceptance.FlipRate(W, H, s => fence.Stage.Setup(s, aa, preset),
                (s, n) => fence.Draw(s, n * PanPixelsPerFrame), fence.Region, Warm, Measured);
        }

        [GpuFact(RequiresFourSampleMsaa = true)]
        public void APanOverThinGeometryFlickersLessThanMsaa4xAtNative() =>
            AssertCalmer("fence pan, Native", FenceFlips(AntiAliasing.Msaa(4), TemporalUpscale.Native),
                FenceFlips(AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Native));

        [GpuFact(RequiresFourSampleMsaa = true)]
        public void APanOverThinGeometryFlickersLessThanMsaa4xAtQuality() =>
            AssertCalmer("fence pan, Quality", FenceFlips(AntiAliasing.Msaa(4), TemporalUpscale.Native),
                FenceFlips(AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality));

        [GpuFact(RequiresFourSampleMsaa = true)]
        public void TheDefaultIsometricCameraZoomingDoesNotSwim()
        {
            double Flips(AntiAliasing aa)
            {
                var yard = new IsoYard(W, H);
                return TemporalAcceptance.FlipRate(W, H, s => yard.Setup(s, aa), yard.Draw,
                    new PixelRect(W / 10, H / 10, W * 9 / 10, H * 9 / 10), Warm, 48);
            }
            AssertCalmer("isometric zoom", Flips(AntiAliasing.Msaa(4)), Flips(AntiAliasing.Temporal));
        }

        // A 6 m box on a 24 m tall view (13 cm a pixel), so the 16.7 cm dissolve noise cells are near pixel size.
        static readonly Vector3 PropSize = new(6f, 6f, 1f);

        static void DrawProp(FrontStage stage, Scene3D s, float panPixels, float dissolve, bool crossfade)
        {
            s.Camera.Target = new Vector3(panPixels * stage.PixelWorld, 0f, 0f);
            stage.Wall(s);
            Matrix4x4 world = Matrix4x4.CreateScale(PropSize);
            if (dissolve <= 0f) { s.Draw(stage.Box, world, new Color(0.95f, 0.85f, 0.6f, 1f)); return; }
            s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, world)
            {
                Tint = new Color(0.95f, 0.85f, 0.6f, 1f), Dissolve = dissolve, DissolveEdgeWidth = 0.001f, DissolveEdgeColor = Color.Black,
            });
            if (crossfade)
                s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, world)
                {
                    Tint = new Color(0.2f, 0.35f, 0.8f, 1f), Dissolve = dissolve, DissolveEdgeWidth = 0.001f,
                    DissolveEdgeColor = Color.Black, DissolveComplement = 1f,
                });
        }

        [GpuFact(RequiresFourSampleMsaa = true)]
        public void APropHeldAtHalfDissolveConvergesAndFlickersLessThanMsaa4x()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 24f);
            PixelRect prop = new PixelRect(W / 2 - 18, H / 2 - 18, W / 2 + 18, H / 2 + 18);

            // Still camera: after 48 frames the coverage is partial and steady.
            byte[] solid, absent, held;
            var still = new FlipCounter(W, H, prop);
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(32, (s, _) => DrawProp(stage, s, 0f, 0.5f, false));
                held = Array.Empty<byte>();
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { held = fx.Frame((s, _) => DrawProp(stage, s, 0f, 0.5f, false)); still.Add(held); }
            }
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(31, (s, _) => DrawProp(stage, s, 0f, 0f, false));
                solid = fx.Frame((s, _) => DrawProp(stage, s, 0f, 0f, false));
            }
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(31, (s, _) => stage.Wall(s));
                absent = fx.Frame((s, _) => stage.Wall(s));
            }
            double lSolid = TemporalAcceptance.MeanLuma(solid, W, prop), lAbsent = TemporalAcceptance.MeanLuma(absent, W, prop);
            double coverage = (TemporalAcceptance.MeanLuma(held, W, prop) - lAbsent) / (lSolid - lAbsent);
            _out.WriteLine($"half dissolve, still: coverage {coverage:0.000}, flips per pixel per frame {still.FlipsPerPixelPerFrame:0.0000}");
            Assert.InRange(coverage, MinHeldCoverage, MaxHeldCoverage);
            Assert.True(still.FlipsPerPixelPerFrame <= MaxHeldFlipRate, $"a held dissolve must not crawl, {still.FlipsPerPixelPerFrame:0.0000}");

            // Slow pan: fewer flips than MSAA 4x.
            double Flips(AntiAliasing aa) => TemporalAcceptance.FlipRate(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, aa),
                (s, n) => DrawProp(stage, s, n * PanPixelsPerFrame, 0.5f, false), prop, Warm, Measured);
            AssertCalmer("half dissolve pan", Flips(AntiAliasing.Msaa(4)), Flips(AntiAliasing.Temporal));
        }

        [GpuFact(RequiresFourSampleMsaa = true)]
        public void ALodCrossfadeDitherFlickersLessThanMsaa4x()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 24f);
            PixelRect prop = new PixelRect(W / 2 - 18, H / 2 - 18, W / 2 + 18, H / 2 + 18);
            double Flips(AntiAliasing aa) => TemporalAcceptance.FlipRate(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, aa),
                (s, n) => DrawProp(stage, s, n * PanPixelsPerFrame, 0.5f, true), prop, Warm, Measured);
            AssertCalmer("LOD crossfade pan", Flips(AntiAliasing.Msaa(4)), Flips(AntiAliasing.Temporal));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>
    /// TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 3: a keyed object crossing the view leaves no trail longer
    /// than one display pixel two frames after it passes, and a particle burst over a moving background does the
    /// same. Plus review focus 1 (a 10 m keyed teleport inside the 16 m auto-cut distance moves by the jump and
    /// leaves no trail), 2 (an orthographic zoom leaves no ghost) and 5 (the crossing with its key omitted). Each run
    /// is compared against the same fixture path with the object left out, at the same frame index and jitter.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalGhostingGoldenTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180;
        const float Tolerance = 0.05f;

        // Acceptance thresholds, first estimates the first real-Metal run retunes in one place.
        const int MinTrailPixels = 100;                      // a trail region smaller than this measured nothing
        const int AllowedOverOneIn = 200;                    // at most one pixel in 200 of a region may stay over Tolerance
        const float MaxMotionErrorInternalPixels = 0.05f;    // the jump frame's motion against the jump
        const float GhostTolerance = 0.2f, GhostEdgeStep = 0.08f;   // GhostPixels' luma difference and reference edge step
        const int AllowedGhostOneIn = 500;                   // at most one ghost pixel in 500 of the frame
        const int MinBurstPixels = 400;                      // a burst region smaller than this measured nothing

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalGhostingGoldenTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        static byte[] RunTo(FrontStage stage, int lastFrame, Action<Scene3D, int> draw)
        {
            using var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal));
            fx.Frames(lastFrame, draw);
            return fx.Frame(draw);
        }

        void AssertNoTrail(string what, byte[] frame, byte[] background, IReadOnlyList<PixelRect> footprints)
        {
            var (over, check, worst) = TemporalAcceptance.Trail(frame, background, W, H, footprints, Tolerance);
            _out.WriteLine($"{what}: {over} of {check} trail pixels over {Tolerance}, worst {worst:0.000}");
            Assert.True(check > MinTrailPixels, $"{what}: the trail region holds {check} pixels, so nothing was measured");
            Assert.True(over <= Math.Max(1, check / AllowedOverOneIn), $"{what}: {over} of {check} pixels the object left two or more frames ago still differ from the background by more than {Tolerance} (worst {worst:0.000})");
        }

        void Crossing(bool keyed)
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 4.5f);
            const int still = 16, last = 39;
            var size = new Vector3(0.75f, 0.75f, 0.5f);
            Vector3 At(int n) => new(-2.5f + Math.Max(0, n - still) * 4f * stage.PixelWorld, 0f, 0f);
            void Draw(Scene3D s, int n)
            {
                stage.Wall(s);
                if (n < still) return;
                Matrix4x4 world = Matrix4x4.CreateScale(size) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(At(n));
                if (keyed) s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, world) { Tint = new Color(1f, 0.25f, 0.2f, 1f), Motion = MotionKey.From(11) });
                else s.Draw(stage.Box, world, new Color(1f, 0.25f, 0.2f, 1f));
            }
            byte[] frame = RunTo(stage, last, Draw);
            byte[] wall = RunTo(stage, last, (s, _) => stage.Wall(s));
            var cam = new IsoCamera3D { Azimuth = 0f, Elevation = 0f, AspectRatio = (float)W / H, OrthoSize = stage.OrthoSize };
            var footprints = new List<PixelRect>();
            for (int k = 0; k <= 8; k++)
                footprints.Add(TemporalAcceptance.Footprint(cam, At(last - k) - size * 0.5f, At(last - k) + size * 0.5f, W, H));
            AssertNoTrail(keyed ? "keyed crossing" : "unkeyed crossing", frame, wall, footprints);
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void AKeyedCrossingObjectLeavesNoTrail() => Crossing(keyed: true);

        [GpuFact]
        public void AnUnkeyedCrossingObjectLeavesNoTrail() => Crossing(keyed: false);

        [GpuFact]
        public void AKeyedTeleportWithinTheCutDistanceMovesByTheJumpAndLeavesNoTrail()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 24f);   // 13 cm a pixel, so a 10 m jump stays on screen
            var size = new Vector3(1.5f, 1.5f, 1f);
            Vector3 from = new(-6f, 0f, 0f), to = new(4f, 0f, 0f);
            const int jump = 24;
            void Draw(Scene3D s, int n)
            {
                stage.Wall(s);
                s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(size) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(n < jump ? from : to))
                { Tint = new Color(1f, 0.25f, 0.2f, 1f), Motion = MotionKey.From(12) });
            }

            byte[] after;
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(jump, Draw);
                fx.Frame(Draw);                                   // the jump frame
                Assert.True(fx.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.HistoryValid, "a keyed body's jump must not reset history");
                var (motion, mw, mh) = fx.Scene.ReadMotionTargetForTests();
                PixelRect landed = stage.Footprint(fx.Scene, to, size);
                int cx = (landed.X0 + landed.X1) / 2 * mw / W, cy = (landed.Y0 + landed.Y1) / 2 * mh / H;
                Vector2 m = motion[cy * mw + cx];
                float want = (to.X - from.X) / (stage.OrthoSize * W / H);   // the jump as a fraction of the view width
                _out.WriteLine($"teleport: motion {m.X:0.00000},{m.Y:0.00000} against {want:0.00000},0");
                Assert.True(MathF.Abs(m.X - want) <= MaxMotionErrorInternalPixels / mw && MathF.Abs(m.Y) <= MaxMotionErrorInternalPixels / mh,
                    $"the jump frame's motion must equal the jump within {MaxMotionErrorInternalPixels} internal pixels: {m} against ({want}, 0)");
                after = fx.Frame(Draw);                           // two frames after the body left 'from'
            }
            byte[] wall = RunTo(stage, jump + 1, (s, _) => stage.Wall(s));
            var cam = new IsoCamera3D { Azimuth = 0f, Elevation = 0f, AspectRatio = (float)W / H, OrthoSize = stage.OrthoSize };
            PixelRect Rect(Vector3 c) => TemporalAcceptance.Footprint(cam, c - size * 0.5f, c + size * 0.5f, W, H);
            AssertNoTrail("teleport", after, wall, new[] { Rect(to), Rect(to), Rect(from) });
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void AnOrthographicZoomLeavesNoGhost()
        {
            var yard = new IsoYard(W, H);
            int[] checkpoints = { 28, 34, 40, 46 };
            var references = new Dictionary<int, byte[]>();
            foreach (int n in checkpoints)
            {
                float zoom = yard.ZoomAt(n);
                references[n] = TemporalAcceptance.Snapshot(W, H, s => yard.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Ssaa(4f)), s => yard.DrawAtZoom(s, zoom));
            }
            using var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => yard.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal));
            for (int n = 0; n <= 46; n++)
            {
                byte[] frame = fx.Frame(yard.Draw);
                if (!references.TryGetValue(n, out byte[]? reference)) continue;
                int ghosts = TemporalAcceptance.GhostPixels(frame, reference, W, H, GhostTolerance, GhostEdgeStep);
                _out.WriteLine($"zoom {yard.ZoomAt(n):0.000} at frame {n}: {ghosts} ghost pixels");
                Assert.True(ghosts <= W * H / AllowedGhostOneIn, $"frame {n} shows {ghosts} ghost pixels away from the reference's edges");
            }
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void AParticleBurstOverAMovingBackgroundLeavesNoTrail()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 4.5f);
            const int burstStart = 20, burstEnd = 24, check = 25;   // particles on 20 to 23, two frames after 23 is 25
            var centre = new Vector3(0.5f, 0.2f, 0f);
            void Background(Scene3D s, int n)
            {
                s.Camera.Target = new Vector3(n * 2f * stage.PixelWorld, 0f, 0f);   // pan 2 display pixels a frame
                stage.StripedWall(s);
            }
            void Draw(Scene3D s, int n)
            {
                Background(s, n);
                if (n < burstStart || n >= burstEnd) return;
                for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
                    s.DrawParticle(new ParticleSprite
                    {
                        Position = centre + new Vector3(0.5f * MathF.Cos(i * 2.4f) * (i % 5) / 5f, 0.5f * MathF.Sin(i * 2.4f) * (i % 5) / 5f, 0.5f),
                        Size = 0.25f,
                        Color = new Color(1f, 0.8f, 0.4f, 1f),
                        Shape = ParticleShape.SoftGlow,
                        Blend = BillboardBlend.Additive,
                        LifeNorm = 0.3f,
                        Seed = i,
                    });
            }
            byte[] frame, wall;
            PixelRect burst;
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(check, Draw);
                frame = fx.Frame(Draw);
                burst = TemporalAcceptance.Footprint(fx.Scene.Camera, centre - new Vector3(0.7f, 0.7f, 0f), centre + new Vector3(0.7f, 0.7f, 0.6f), W, H);
            }
            wall = RunTo(stage, check, Background);
            int over = 0;
            float worst = 0f;
            for (int y = burst.Y0; y < burst.Y1; y++)
                for (int x = burst.X0; x < burst.X1; x++)
                {
                    float d = MathF.Abs(TemporalAcceptance.Luma(frame, W, x, y) - TemporalAcceptance.Luma(wall, W, x, y));
                    worst = MathF.Max(worst, d);
                    if (d > Tolerance) over++;
                }
            _out.WriteLine($"particle burst: {over} of {burst.Area} pixels over {Tolerance}, worst {worst:0.000}");
            Assert.True(burst.Area > MinBurstPixels, "the burst region is too small to measure");
            Assert.True(over <= burst.Area / AllowedOverOneIn, $"the burst left {over} of {burst.Area} pixels over {Tolerance} two frames after it ended (worst {worst:0.000})");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 4: a revealed background shows no history from the
    /// red occluder that covered it for 32 frames, on the very first frame after the reveal.</summary>
    public sealed class TemporalDisocclusionGoldenTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180;

        // Acceptance thresholds, first estimates the first real-Metal run retunes in one place: red excess over the
        // bare wall in 8-bit steps.
        const double MaxMeanRedExcess = 3;
        const int MaxWorstRedExcess = 20;

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalDisocclusionGoldenTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        [GpuFact]
        public void ARevealedBackgroundCarriesNoHistoryFromItsOccluder()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 4.5f);
            var size = new Vector3(1.5f, 1.5f, 0.5f);           // 60 by 60 display pixels
            Vector3 a = new(-1f, 0f, 0f), b = new(2f, 0f, 0f);  // 120 pixels apart, so the footprints do not overlap
            const int reveal = 32;
            void Draw(Scene3D s, int n)
            {
                stage.Wall(s);
                s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(size) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(n < reveal ? a : b))
                { Tint = new Color(1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 1f), Motion = MotionKey.From(21) });
            }
            byte[] frame, wall;
            PixelRect revealed;
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(reveal, Draw);
                frame = fx.Frame(Draw);
                revealed = stage.Footprint(fx.Scene, a, size).Inflate(-1);
            }
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(reveal, (s, _) => stage.Wall(s));
                wall = fx.Frame((s, _) => stage.Wall(s));
            }
            double sum = 0; int worst = 0;
            for (int y = revealed.Y0; y < revealed.Y1; y++)
                for (int x = revealed.X0; x < revealed.X1; x++)
                {
                    int i = (y * W + x) * 4;
                    int red = Math.Max(0, frame[i] - wall[i]);
                    sum += red;
                    worst = Math.Max(worst, red);
                }
            double mean = sum / revealed.Area;
            _out.WriteLine($"revealed {revealed.Area} pixels: mean red excess {mean:0.00} steps, worst {worst}");
            Assert.True(mean <= MaxMeanRedExcess, $"the revealed wall carries the occluder's red, mean {mean:0.00} steps");
            Assert.True(worst <= MaxWorstRedExcess, $"a revealed pixel carries the occluder's red, worst {worst} steps");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>
    /// TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 5 and review focus 3: the frame after CameraCut, a resize
    /// that moves the internal size, or a preset change matches a from-scratch render. The from-scratch fixture
    /// begins the same number of frames without rendering them, so both frames share one frame index and jitter
    /// phase, and with history invalid in both the two must agree to rounding.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalResetGoldenTests
    {
        // Rounding between two renders of the same frame, in 8-bit steps: the worst channel and the mean.
        const int MaxWorstStep = 1;
        const double MaxMeanStep = 0.05;

        static void Layout(FrontStage stage, Scene3D s, int n, float cameraX, bool second)
        {
            s.Camera.Target = new Vector3(cameraX, 0f, 0f);
            stage.Wall(s);
            Vector3 body = second ? new Vector3(cameraX + 1f, -0.5f, 0f) : new Vector3(cameraX - 1.5f + 0.02f * n, 0.4f, 0f);
            s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(0.9f) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(body))
            { Tint = second ? new Color(0.2f, 0.4f, 0.9f, 1f) : new Color(0.9f, 0.3f, 0.2f, 1f), Motion = MotionKey.From(51) });
            s.Draw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(0.3f, 2f, 0.3f) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(cameraX + (second ? -2f : 2f), 0f, 0f),
                new Color(0.9f, 0.9f, 0.85f, 1f));
        }

        static void AssertMatchesFromScratch(byte[] a, byte[] b, int w, int h, string what)
        {
            Assert.Equal(b.Length, a.Length);
            int worst = 0; long sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++)
            {
                if ((i & 3) == 3) continue;
                int d = Math.Abs(a[i] - b[i]);
                worst = Math.Max(worst, d);
                sum += d;
            }
            double mean = sum / (3.0 * w * h);
            Assert.True(worst <= MaxWorstStep && mean <= MaxMeanStep, $"{what}: the frame after the reset differs from a from-scratch render (worst {worst} steps, mean {mean:0.000})");
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void TheFrameAfterCameraCutMatchesAFromScratchRender()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(320, 180, 4.5f);
            byte[] cut, scratch;
            using (var a = new TemporalFixture(320, 180, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                a.Frames(20, (s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
                a.Scene.CameraCut();
                cut = a.Frame((s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 6f, true));   // 6 m, inside the automatic cut distance
                Assert.Equal(TemporalResetReason.CameraCutRequested, a.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.LastReset);
                Assert.False(a.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.HistoryValid);
            }
            using (var b = new TemporalFixture(320, 180, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                b.SkipFrames(20);
                scratch = b.Frame((s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 6f, true));
            }
            AssertMatchesFromScratch(cut, scratch, 320, 180, "CameraCut");
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void TheFrameAfterAResizeThatMovesTheInternalSizeMatchesAFromScratchRender()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(320, 180, 4.5f);   // 480 by 270 keeps the aspect, so the camera is unchanged
            byte[] resized, scratch;
            using (var a = new TemporalFixture(320, 180, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality)))
            {
                a.Frames(20, (s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
                int before = a.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.InternalWidth;
                a.Resize(480, 270);
                resized = a.Frame((s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
                TemporalDiagnostics d = a.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics;
                Assert.Equal(TemporalResetReason.Resize, d.LastReset);
                Assert.InRange(before, 212, 214);
                Assert.InRange(d.InternalWidth, 319, 321);
            }
            using (var b = new TemporalFixture(480, 270, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality)))
            {
                b.SkipFrames(20);
                scratch = b.Frame((s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
            }
            AssertMatchesFromScratch(resized, scratch, 480, 270, "Resize");
        }

        // Performance halves each axis. UltraPerformance, group E's fifth preset, takes a third, 107 by 60 here, with a
        // 72-phase jitter cycle, and must reset as cleanly.
        [GpuTheory]
        [InlineData(TemporalUpscale.Performance)]
        [InlineData(TemporalUpscale.UltraPerformance)]
        public void TheFrameAfterAPresetChangeMatchesAFromScratchRender(TemporalUpscale to)
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(320, 180, 4.5f);
            byte[] changed, scratch;
            using (var a = new TemporalFixture(320, 180, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality)))
            {
                a.Frames(20, (s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
                a.Scene.Post.Temporal.Upscale = to;
                changed = a.Frame((s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
                Assert.Equal(TemporalResetReason.RenderScale, a.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.LastReset);
                Assert.Equal(to, a.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.Preset);
            }
            using (var b = new TemporalFixture(320, 180, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, to)))
            {
                b.SkipFrames(20);
                scratch = b.Frame((s, n) => Layout(stage, s, n, 0f, false));
            }
            AssertMatchesFromScratch(changed, scratch, 320, 180, $"preset change to {to}");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 6: at Quality a converged still frame is closer to a
    /// native reference than the same frame bilinearly upscaled, on a resolution chart. The same frame is the chart
    /// converged by temporal anti-aliasing at Native on a display the size of Quality's internal target.</summary>
    public sealed class TemporalUpscalingGoldenTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180, IW = 213, IH = 120;

        // Acceptance threshold, a first estimate the first real-Metal run retunes in one place: Quality's error
        // against native, as a share of the bilinear upscale's.
        const double MaxErrorShareOfBilinear = 0.85;

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalUpscalingGoldenTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        // Five groups of five bars, bar and gap equal at 3, 2, 1.5, 1.2 and 1 display pixel: vertical bars on the top
        // row, horizontal bars on the bottom row, and a square turned 20 degrees between them.
        static void Chart(FrontStage stage, Scene3D s)
        {
            float px = 4.5f / H;
            float[] widths = { 3f, 2f, 1.5f, 1.2f, 1f };
            var white = new Color(0.95f, 0.95f, 0.95f, 1f);
            for (int g = 0; g < widths.Length; g++)
            {
                float bar = widths[g] * px, left = -3.6f + g * 1.5f;
                for (int b = 0; b < 5; b++)
                {
                    float o = left + b * 2f * bar;
                    s.Draw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(bar, 1.2f, 0.1f) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(o, 1.2f, 0f), white);
                    s.Draw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(1.2f, bar, 0.1f) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(left + 0.6f, -1.8f + b * 2f * bar, 0f), white);
                }
            }
            s.Draw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(0.9f, 0.9f, 0.1f) * Matrix4x4.CreateRotationZ(0.35f) * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(0f, -0.2f, 0f), white);
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void QualityUpscalingBeatsABilinearUpscaleOfTheSameFrame()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 4.5f);
            var low = new FrontStage(IW, IH, 4.5f);
            byte[] native = TemporalAcceptance.Snapshot(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Ssaa(8f)), s => Chart(stage, s));

            byte[] quality;
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality)))
            {
                fx.Frames(47, (s, _) => Chart(stage, s));
                quality = fx.Frame((s, _) => Chart(stage, s));
                Assert.InRange(fx.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.InternalWidth, IW - 1, IW + 1);
            }
            byte[] small;
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(IW, IH, s => low.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Native)))
            {
                fx.Frames(47, (s, _) => Chart(low, s));
                small = fx.Frame((s, _) => Chart(low, s));
            }
            byte[] bilinear = TemporalAcceptance.BilinearUpscale(small, IW, IH, W, H);

            var all = new PixelRect(4, 4, W - 4, H - 4);
            double eq = TemporalAcceptance.MeanAbsLuma(quality, native, W, all);
            double eb = TemporalAcceptance.MeanAbsLuma(bilinear, native, W, all);
            _out.WriteLine($"mean abs luma against native: Quality upscale {eq:0.0000}, bilinear upscale {eb:0.0000}");
            Assert.True(eq < MaxErrorShareOfBilinear * eb, $"Quality must be at least 15% closer to native than a bilinear upscale: {eq:0.0000} against {eb:0.0000}");
            GoldenCompare.AssertOrUpdate("temporal_upscale_quality_chart", quality, W, H);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 7: a textured checkerboard at Performance keeps the
    /// native reference's detail within tolerance, and the bias is what keeps it (the same frame with the bias
    /// cancelled loses detail).</summary>
    public sealed class TemporalMipBiasGoldenTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180;

        // Acceptance thresholds, first estimates the first real-Metal run retunes in one place.
        const double MinDetailKept = 0.8;            // biased Performance detail as a share of native's
        const double MaxUnbiasedDetailShare = 0.9;   // unbiased detail as a share of biased, so the bias is what keeps it
        const double MaxBandLumaError = 0.08;        // mean luma error against native in the band

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalMipBiasGoldenTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        static byte[] Checker()
        {
            var rgba = new byte[256 * 256 * 4];
            for (int y = 0; y < 256; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < 256; x++)
                {
                    byte v = ((x / 8 + y / 8) & 1) == 0 ? (byte)38 : (byte)217;
                    int i = (y * 256 + x) * 4;
                    rgba[i] = rgba[i + 1] = rgba[i + 2] = v;
                    rgba[i + 3] = 255;
                }
            return rgba;
        }

        // A 16 by 30 m ground quad, two texture repeats a metre, both windings so culling cannot hide it.
        static GltfMesh Ground()
        {
            var n = Vector3.UnitY; var c = Vector4.One;
            var v = new[]
            {
                new ModelVertex(new Vector3(-8f, 0f, 0.5f), n, c, new Vector2(-16f, 1f)),
                new ModelVertex(new Vector3(8f, 0f, 0.5f), n, c, new Vector2(16f, 1f)),
                new ModelVertex(new Vector3(8f, 0f, 30.5f), n, c, new Vector2(16f, 61f)),
                new ModelVertex(new Vector3(-8f, 0f, 30.5f), n, c, new Vector2(-16f, 61f)),
            };
            return new GltfMesh(v, new ushort[] { 0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3, 0, 2, 1, 0, 3, 2 });
        }

        static byte[] Converged(TemporalUpscale preset, float mipBiasOffset, int frames)
        {
            MeshHandle ground = default;
            using var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s =>
            {
                s.Post.UseSmoothPreset();
                s.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = AntiAliasing.Temporal;
                s.Post.Temporal.Upscale = preset;
                s.Post.Temporal.MipBiasOffset = mipBiasOffset;
                s.Post.TransparentBackground = false;
                s.Post.AmbientColor = new Color(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
                s.CameraOverride = new FlyCamera3D { Position = new Vector3(0f, 1.5f, 0f), Pitch = -0.45f, AspectRatio = (float)W / H };
                ground = s.LoadMesh(Ground(), s.LoadTexture(Checker(), 256, 256));
            });
            fx.Frames(frames - 1, (s, _) => s.Draw(ground, Matrix4x4.Identity));
            return fx.Frame((s, _) => s.Draw(ground, Matrix4x4.Identity));
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void ACheckerboardAtPerformanceKeepsTheNativeReferencesDetail()
        {
            byte[] native = Converged(TemporalUpscale.Native, -0.5f, 32);
            byte[] biased = Converged(TemporalUpscale.Performance, -0.5f, 48);
            byte[] unbiased = Converged(TemporalUpscale.Performance, 1f, 48);   // log2(0.5) + 1 cancels the bias

            var band = new PixelRect(W / 5, H * 35 / 100, W * 4 / 5, H * 70 / 100);
            double cN = TemporalAcceptance.LocalContrast(native, W, H, band);
            double cB = TemporalAcceptance.LocalContrast(biased, W, H, band);
            double cU = TemporalAcceptance.LocalContrast(unbiased, W, H, band);
            double err = TemporalAcceptance.MeanAbsLuma(biased, native, W, band);
            _out.WriteLine($"local contrast: native {cN:0.0000}, Performance biased {cB:0.0000}, Performance unbiased {cU:0.0000}, biased error {err:0.0000}");
            Assert.True(cB >= MinDetailKept * cN, $"Performance must keep {MinDetailKept:P0} of the native detail: {cB:0.0000} against {cN:0.0000}");
            Assert.True(cU < MaxUnbiasedDetailShare * cB, $"the bias must be what keeps it: unbiased {cU:0.0000} against biased {cB:0.0000}");
            Assert.True(err <= MaxBandLumaError, $"Performance must stay within {MaxBandLumaError} mean luma of native in the band, got {err:0.0000}");
            GoldenCompare.AssertOrUpdate("temporal_mipbias_checker_performance", biased, W, H);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Gpu;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 10: a steady frame with temporal anti-aliasing,
    /// the sharpen and a keyed mover allocates nothing, with and without a round 2 debug view. Measured over the fake
    /// device, which allocates nothing of its own, and on the real Metal device over the recording alone.</summary>
    [Collection("AllocSensitive")]   // a zero-allocation reading measures its neighbours too (#264)
    public sealed class TemporalSteadyFrameAllocationTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(SceneDebugView.None)]
        [InlineData(SceneDebugView.History)]
        public void ASteadyTemporalFrameAllocatesNothing(SceneDebugView view)
        {
            using var device = new FakeGpuDevice();
            var factory = (FakeGpuResourceFactory)device.Factory;
            using IGpuTexture targetTexture = factory.CreateTexture(GpuTextureDescription.Texture2D(
                160, 90, GpuPixelFormat.R8G8B8A8UNorm, GpuTextureUsage.RenderTarget | GpuTextureUsage.Sampled));
            using IGpuFramebuffer target = factory.CreateFramebuffer(null, targetTexture);
            using var scene = new Scene3D(device, target.Outputs, new ShadowSettings { Mode = ShadowMode.Off });
            scene.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = AntiAliasing.Temporal;
            scene.Post.Temporal.Upscale = TemporalUpscale.Quality;
            scene.DebugView = view;
            MeshHandle box = scene.LoadMesh(MeshPrimitives.Box(1f));
            using IGpuCommandList commands = factory.CreateCommandList();
            int frame = 0;

            void Frame()
            {
                scene.Begin();
                scene.Draw(box, Matrix4x4.Identity);
                scene.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(box, Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(0.01f * frame++, 0f, 2f)) { Motion = MotionKey.From(5) });
                scene.PrepareFrame();
                commands.Begin();
                scene.RenderInternal(commands, 160, 90, target);
                commands.End();
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) Frame();   // size every grow-only buffer, build every lazy pass
            AllocAssert.NoPerCallAllocation($"20 steady temporal frames, debug view {view}", () =>
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) Frame();
            });
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void RecordingASteadyTemporalFrameOnTheDeviceAllocatesNothing()
        {
            if (GpuBackendSelector.Select() != GpuBackendKind.MetalNative) return;   // the Metal leg is the measured one
            var stage = new FrontStage(320, 180, 4.5f);
            using var fx = new TemporalFixture(320, 180, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality));
            Scene3D scene = fx.Scene;
            IGpuDevice gd = fx.Device;
            using IGpuCommandList cl = gd.Factory.CreateCommandList();
            int n = 0;

            long Frame()
            {
                scene.Begin();
                stage.Wall(scene);
                scene.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(0.01f * n++, 0f, 0f)) { Motion = MotionKey.From(3) });
                scene.PrepareFrame();
                long before = System.GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
                cl.Begin();
                scene.RenderInternal(cl, 320, 180, fx.Target);
                cl.End();
                long delta = System.GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - before;
                gd.Submit(cl);
                gd.WaitForIdle();
                return delta;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) Frame();
            long first = 0, retry = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) first += Frame();
            if (first != 0) for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) retry += Frame();
            Assert.True(first == 0 || retry == 0, $"recording 20 steady temporal frames allocated {first} bytes, then {retry} on the retry");
        }
    }
}
```

`TemporalResolveCostPerfGpuTests.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Gpu;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>
    /// TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN section 7 item 9, the engine half: the resolve and the sharpen together cost
    /// under 1.0 ms at a 2560x1440 display on Apple silicon. Interleaved blocks toggle one scene between Quality
    /// temporal anti-aliasing and anti-aliasing off on a fixed internal target of the same size, median over the
    /// blocks, so the difference is an upper bound on resolve plus sharpen (it also carries the motion target, the
    /// opaque copy and a display-size tonemap). The Grimhollow town and meadow measurement is round 3's.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalResolveCostPerfGpuTests
    {
        const int W = 2560, H = 1440, Rounds = 15, Warm = 2, Block = 12;

        // The spec's budget for the resolve and the sharpen together, in ms at a 2560x1440 display.
        const double ResolveBudgetMs = 1.0;

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalResolveCostPerfGpuTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        static double Median(List<double> xs) { xs.Sort(); return xs.Count % 2 == 1 ? xs[xs.Count / 2] : 0.5 * (xs[xs.Count / 2 - 1] + xs[xs.Count / 2]); }

        [GpuFact(RequiresRealGpu = true)]
        public void ResolveAndSharpenCostUnderOneMillisecondAt1440p()
        {
            if (GpuBackendSelector.Select() != GpuBackendKind.MetalNative) { _out.WriteLine("measured on Apple silicon only"); return; }
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 4.5f);
            using var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => stage.Setup(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, TemporalUpscale.Quality));
            Scene3D scene = fx.Scene;
            void Draw(Scene3D s, int n)
            {
                stage.Wall(s);
                for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++)
                    s.Draw(new RigidInstanceDraw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(-3f + 0.5f * i + 0.002f * n, 0.3f * (i % 3), 0f))
                    { Tint = new Color(0.8f, 0.6f, 0.4f, 1f), Motion = MotionKey.From((ulong)(100 + i)) });
            }
            var taa = new List<double>();
            var off = new List<double>();
            for (int r = 0; r < Rounds; r++)
                foreach (bool temporal in new[] { true, false })
                {
                    scene.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = temporal ? AntiAliasing.Temporal : AntiAliasing.Off;
                    scene.Post.RenderScale = temporal ? RenderScale.MatchViewport : RenderScale.FixedInternal;
                    scene.Post.RenderWidth = 1707;
                    scene.Post.RenderHeight = 960;
                    fx.Frames(Warm, Draw);
                    long t0 = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
                    fx.Frames(Block, Draw);
                    (temporal ? taa : off).Add(Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(t0).TotalMilliseconds / Block);
                }
            double taaMs = Median(taa), offMs = Median(off), delta = taaMs - offMs;
            _out.WriteLine($"{fx.Device.Backend} {W}x{H} Quality: temporal {taaMs:0.000} ms a frame, off at 1707x960 {offMs:0.000} ms, resolve and sharpen at most {delta:0.000} ms");
            Assert.True(delta < ResolveBudgetMs, $"resolve and sharpen must cost under {ResolveBudgetMs} ms at 2560x1440, measured at most {delta:0.000} ms");
        }
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `TemporalResolveUniforms`, `TemporalResolveMath.BuildUniforms` (Task E3), `ShaderSources.TemporalResolveCoreGlsl` (Task E5), `PrepareTemporalResolve`, `TemporalResolveRendererForTests` and `TemporalResolveRenderer.LastUniforms` (Tasks E6 and E10), `PixelPostProcessSettings.Background` (`KhaozEngine.Render3D/PixelPostProcessSettings.cs:141-151`) and `Starfield` (`:133`, default true), `SkySettings.SunDirectionOverride` (`KhaozEngine.Render3D/SkySettings.cs:87`), `Scene3D.CameraOverride` (`KhaozEngine.Render3D/Scene3D.cs:185`), `FlyCamera3D` (`KhaozEngine.Render3D/Camera/FlyCamera3D.cs:18-76`), group D's `TemporalFixture` and F9's `PixelRect`, `FlipCounter` and `TemporalAcceptance`.
- Produces:
  ```csharp
  // TemporalResolveMath:
  public static TemporalResolveUniforms BuildUniforms(in TemporalViewInput current, TemporalViewInput? previous,
      Vector2 jitterPixels, int internalWidth, int internalHeight, int displayWidth, int displayHeight,
      bool historyValid, int phaseCount, bool screenFixedBackground = false);
  // TemporalResolveUniforms.Params.y: 1 when the background is fixed to the screen, so background pixels take zero motion
  ```

The starfield is fixed to the screen. `StarfieldFrag` places each star by `gl_FragCoord.xy * Res.xy` on a 220 by 124
cell grid (`KhaozEngine.Render3D/Internal/ShaderSources.Sky.cs:40-52`), so a star stays on its pixel whatever the
camera does. The sky is not: its sun disc sits at the screen projection of a world direction
(`SkyMath.ProjectSunWorldToNdc`, `KhaozEngine.Render3D/Internal/SkyMath.cs:40-80`). Group E's resolve reprojects every
background pixel by the camera's rotation alone (`BackgroundToPrevious`, Task E3), which is right for the sky and wrong
for the stars: under a turning camera the stars' history is fetched from where the rotation says they came from, where
there is no star, and the variance clip fights it every frame. The resolve block's `Params` has three free lanes
(Task E3: "yzw reserved"), so `Params.y` carries a flag, 1 when the background is the starfield, and the background
branch reprojects in place when it is set. Nothing else changes: the uniform size, the layout, and every program's
bindings stay, and with the flag clear the branch is the one group E wrote. The `.fragment` rows of the three
programs that splice `TemporalResolveCoreGlsl` move (Task E6's `TemporalResolve`, Task F7's `TemporalDebugView`, Task
F8's `TemporalCountProbe`), so the debug views and the count probe see the same decision.

```csharp
    /// Which background the temporal resolve reprojects in place (task F16a): the screen-fixed starfield takes zero
    /// motion through the resolve block's Params.y, while the sky and a solid clear keep group E's rotation
    /// reprojection. Headless, on <see cref="HeadlessSceneRig"/>, plus the maths and the shader text.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalBackgroundMotionTests
    {
        [Theory]
        [InlineData(BackgroundMode.Starfield, 1f)]
        [InlineData(BackgroundMode.Sky, 0f)]
        [InlineData(BackgroundMode.Solid, 0f)]
        public void OnlyTheStarfieldIsScreenFixed(BackgroundMode background, float flag)
        {
            using var rig = new HeadlessSceneRig();
            rig.Scene.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = AntiAliasing.Temporal;
            rig.Scene.Post.Background = background;
            rig.Frame(96, 64);
            rig.Frame(96, 64);
            Assert.Equal(flag, rig.Scene.TemporalResolveRendererForTests!.LastUniforms.Params.Y);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheMathsCarriesTheFlagInParamsYAndChangesNothingElse()
        {
            Matrix4x4 view = Matrix4x4.CreateLookAt(new Vector3(0f, 2f, 10f), Vector3.Zero, Vector3.UnitY);
            Matrix4x4 projection = Matrix4x4.CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView(1f, 1.5f, 0.1f, 500f);
            var input = new TemporalViewInput(view, projection, view * projection);
            TemporalResolveUniforms plain = TemporalResolveMath.BuildUniforms(input, input, Vector2.Zero, 96, 64, 96, 64,
                historyValid: true, phaseCount: 8);
            TemporalResolveUniforms screenFixed = TemporalResolveMath.BuildUniforms(input, input, Vector2.Zero, 96, 64,
                96, 64, historyValid: true, phaseCount: 8, screenFixedBackground: true);
            Assert.Equal(0f, plain.Params.Y);
            Assert.Equal(1f, screenFixed.Params.Y);
            Assert.Equal(plain.Params.X, screenFixed.Params.X);
            Assert.Equal(plain.BackgroundToPrevious, screenFixed.BackgroundToPrevious);
            Assert.Equal(plain.CurrentToPrevious, screenFixed.CurrentToPrevious);
            Assert.Equal(plain.Jitter, screenFixed.Jitter);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheResolveTestsTheFlagBeforeTheRotationReprojection()
        {
            string core = ShaderSources.TemporalResolveCoreGlsl;
            int screenFixed = core.IndexOf("if (closestIsBackground && Params.y > 0.5) {", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            int rotation = core.IndexOf("BackgroundToPrevious * vec4(ndcXY, 1.0, 1.0)", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            Assert.True(screenFixed >= 0, "the resolve has no screen-fixed background branch");
            Assert.True(rotation > screenFixed, "the screen-fixed branch must be tested before the rotation reprojection");
        }
    }
}
```

`KhaozEngine.Render.Tests/Gpu/TemporalStarfieldGpuTests.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D.Internal;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The background under a turning camera (task F16a). The starfield places its stars by pixel, so under temporal
    /// anti-aliasing it takes zero motion and its stars hold still while the camera yaws: no smear, and the flip metric
    /// under threshold. The sky's sun sits in a world direction, so the sky keeps the rotation reprojection and its disc
    /// lands where a still frame at the same pose draws it. No geometry, so every pixel is background.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalStarfieldGpuTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180, Warm = 24, Measured = 16;
        const float YawPerFrame = 0.01f;   // radians, 0.57 degrees a frame, far under the 60 degree automatic cut

        // Acceptance thresholds, first estimates the first real-Metal run retunes in one place.
        const int MinStarPixels = 100;           // the reference frame has to draw at least this many star pixels
        const double MinStarsKept = 0.8;         // share of star pixels still lit after the yaw
        const double MaxYawFlipRate = 0.002;     // flips per pixel per frame under the yaw
        const double MaxFrameDrift = 0.004;      // mean abs luma between consecutive frames
        const double MaxSunMissPixels = 1.0;     // sun centroid distance from the still frame's
        const int MinSunPixels = 10;             // the sun disc's core has to cover at least this many pixels

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalStarfieldGpuTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        static void Stage(Scene3D s, AntiAliasing aa, bool sky)
        {
            s.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = aa;
            s.Post.Temporal.Upscale = TemporalUpscale.Native;
            s.Post.Temporal.Sharpness = 0f;       // the sharpen would add its own ringing around a one-pixel star
            s.Post.Hdr.Enabled = false;           // LDR, so a star and the sun disc read on the 8-bit scale as authored
            s.Post.TransparentBackground = false;
            s.Post.Background = sky ? BackgroundMode.Sky : BackgroundMode.Starfield;   // after the fixture's UseSmoothPreset
            s.Post.Sky.SunDirectionOverride = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(0.1f, 0.12f, 1f));   // ahead and a little up
            s.CameraOverride = new FlyCamera3D
            {
                Position = new Vector3(0f, 1.5f, 0f), Yaw = 0f, Pitch = 0.05f, FieldOfView = MathF.PI / 3f,
                AspectRatio = (float)W / H, NearPlane = 0.1f, FarPlane = 400f,
            };
        }

        // Frame n looks YawPerFrame * n radians round from +Z. Draws nothing.
        static void Turn(Scene3D s, int n) => ((FlyCamera3D)s.CameraOverride!).Yaw = YawPerFrame * n;

        [GpuFact]
        public void AStarfieldHoldsStillWhileTheCameraYaws()
        {
            // The stars do not depend on the camera, so any still frame is the reference for every frame.
            byte[] reference;
            using (var still = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => Stage(s, AntiAliasing.Off, sky: false)))
                reference = still.Frame(Turn);

            var region = new PixelRect(2, 2, W - 2, H - 2);
            var flips = new FlipCounter(W, H, region);
            byte[] last = Array.Empty<byte>(), before = Array.Empty<byte>();
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => Stage(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, sky: false)))
            {
                fx.Frames(Warm, Turn);
                for (int i = 0; i < Measured; i++)
                {
                    before = last;
                    last = fx.Frame(Turn);
                    flips.Add(last);
                }
                Assert.Equal(1f, fx.Scene.TemporalResolveRendererForTests!.LastUniforms.Params.Y);
            }

            int stars = 0, kept = 0;
            for (int y = region.Y0; y < region.Y1; y++)
                for (int x = region.X0; x < region.X1; x++)
                {
                    if (TemporalAcceptance.Luma(reference, W, x, y) < 0.3f) continue;
                    stars++;
                    if (TemporalAcceptance.Luma(last, W, x, y) > 0.15f) kept++;
                }
            double rate = flips.FlipsPerPixelPerFrame;
            double drift = TemporalAcceptance.MeanAbsLuma(last, before, W, region);
            _out.WriteLine($"starfield under a {YawPerFrame} rad a frame yaw: {rate:0.00000} flips per pixel per frame, "
                + $"{kept} of {stars} star pixels kept, frame to frame mean abs luma {drift:0.00000}");
            Assert.True(stars > MinStarPixels, $"the reference drew only {stars} star pixels");
            Assert.True(kept >= MinStarsKept * stars, $"the stars must stay on their pixels: {kept} of {stars} kept");
            Assert.True(rate <= MaxYawFlipRate, $"the starfield must not flicker under a yaw: {rate:0.00000} flips per pixel per frame");
            Assert.True(drift <= MaxFrameDrift, $"consecutive frames must match: mean abs luma {drift:0.00000}");
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void TheSkyKeepsTheRotationReprojectionAndItsSunLandsWhereAStillFrameDrawsIt()
        {
            const int last = Warm + Measured;
            byte[] reference;
            using (var still = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => Stage(s, AntiAliasing.Off, sky: true)))
            {
                still.SkipFrames(last);
                reference = still.Frame(Turn);
            }
            byte[] taa;
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => Stage(s, AntiAliasing.Temporal, sky: true)))
            {
                fx.Frames(last, Turn);
                taa = fx.Frame(Turn);
                TemporalResolveUniforms u = fx.Scene.TemporalResolveRendererForTests!.LastUniforms;
                Assert.Equal(0f, u.Params.Y);
                Assert.Equal(1f, u.Jitter.W);
                Assert.NotEqual(Matrix4x4.Identity, u.BackgroundToPrevious);
            }
            (double X, double Y) want = SunCentroid(reference), got = SunCentroid(taa);
            double miss = Math.Sqrt((want.X - got.X) * (want.X - got.X) + (want.Y - got.Y) * (want.Y - got.Y));
            _out.WriteLine($"sky under a yaw: sun centroid {got.X:0.00},{got.Y:0.00} against a still frame's "
                + $"{want.X:0.00},{want.Y:0.00}, {miss:0.00} px apart");
            Assert.True(miss <= MaxSunMissPixels, $"the sun must follow the rotation reprojection: {miss:0.00} px from the still frame's");
        }

        // The centre of the pixels bright enough to be the sun disc's core (the sun colour's luma is 0.96, the
        // horizon's 0.69).
        static (double X, double Y) SunCentroid(byte[] rgba)
        {
            double sx = 0, sy = 0;
            int count = 0;
            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                    if (TemporalAcceptance.Luma(rgba, W, x, y) > 0.9f) { sx += x; sy += y; count++; }
            Assert.True(count > MinSunPixels, $"the sun disc covered only {count} pixels");
            return (sx / count, sy / count);
        }
    }
}
```

- Produces:
  ```csharp
  // ShaderSources: public static readonly string TemporalEdgeFrag   // program PostTemporalEdge, pipeline "PixelPostProcess temporal edge"
  // PixelPostProcess (now partial):
  internal const int TemporalOutlineDrawCalls = 2;
  internal static bool TemporalOutlineRuns(PixelPostProcessSettings s);   // s.Outline under the effective Temporal mode
  internal bool TemporalOutlineBuilt { get; }
  internal void RunTemporalOutline(IGpuCommandList cl, RenderResources res, IGpuTexture opaque);
  // Scene3D: internal bool TemporalOutlineBuiltForTests { get; }
  ```

`Post.Outline` is the post chain's depth and normal edge pass (`EdgeFrag`, `ShaderSources.Post.cs:139-198`, run by
`RunOutline` in `PixelPostProcess.Run`). Under group E's resolve the chain runs at display resolution after the
resolve, so the pass reads the jittered internal normal and depth and draws one-internal-pixel lines that move with
the jitter every frame (group E amendment 9). Under temporal anti-aliasing only, this task runs the same edge test
on the internal images before the resolve and drops it from the display chain, so the lines are accumulated and
steadied like every other edge:
- The pass outlines `ColorTex` into the internal `PingA`, and the opaque-only copy into the internal `PingB`, and the
  resolve reads those two as its scene colour and opaque colour. The internal pings are free under the resolve: the
  display chain runs on `TemporalPostTargets`' own pings, and nothing else in the engine writes the internal ones
  (`PixelPostProcess` is their only user). The edge mask depends only on the normal and depth the two images share,
  so outlining both keeps the reactive estimate from reading the lines as transparent content.
- `TemporalEdgeFrag` is `EdgeFrag` with two lines changed, spliced at type initialisation so its edge test cannot
  drift from the chain's. It takes its UV from `gl_FragCoord` (upper-left on every backend, the convention
  `StarfieldFrag` and the resolve rely on) times `Texel.xy`, one over the internal size (Task E7 takes the edge texel
  from `NormalTex`). So the outlined images keep `ColorTex`'s orientation, which the resolve reads by `texelFetch`,
  normal and depth are read at the same UV with no parity flip, and the pass counts in no chain parity.
- The display chain drops its outline pass under temporal anti-aliasing, and the blit parity sum drops its outline
  term with it. `passesBeforeOutline` only matters when the chain runs the outline, so it is left as it is.
- With HDR on, the outline now mixes into the linear colour before the tonemap, so its colour passes through the
  tonemap. The default near-black outline is unchanged to the eye. The consumer docs (Task F16) say so.
- With temporal anti-aliasing off `TemporalOutlineRuns` is false, the chain runs `RunOutline` and counts it exactly as
  before, and no program, pipeline or set of this task is built. `GoldenSnapshotTests` pins the outline on in its
  committed 3D goldens (the `scene3d` golden, `GoldenSnapshotTests.cs:40` and `:71`, and 18 others), and
  `Golden3D_OutlineToggle_DoesNotFlip` (`:1392-1428`) renders it both ways, so the full Metal suite is the byte-identity
  proof.
- Task F3's `SharpeningKeepsTheOutlineOnTheSilhouette` detects the outline by its green hue (Task F3), so it keeps
  passing with the outline resolved ahead of the chain, and now proves the sharpen leaves the resolved lines in place.

```csharp
        public void TheProgramIsTheEdgeOutlineAddressedByPixel()
        {
            string frag = ShaderSources.TemporalEdgeFrag;
            Assert.Contains("layout(location=0) in vec2 vUvIn;", frag, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            Assert.Contains("vec2 vUv = gl_FragCoord.xy * Texel.xy + vUvIn * 1.0e-30;", frag, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            Assert.Contains("vec2 nuv = vUv;", frag, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            Assert.DoesNotContain("1.0 - vUv.y", frag, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            int edgeTest = ShaderSources.EdgeFrag.IndexOf("    float edge = 0.0;", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            Assert.True(edgeTest > 0, "EdgeFrag no longer holds its edge test line");
            Assert.EndsWith(ShaderSources.EdgeFrag.Substring(edgeTest), frag, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        [Theory]
        [InlineData(true, true, true)]
        [InlineData(false, true, false)]
        [InlineData(true, false, false)]
        public void TheOutlineRunsAheadOfTheResolveOnlyUnderTemporalAntiAliasing(bool outline, bool temporal, bool ahead)
        {
            var s = new PixelPostProcessSettings { Outline = outline };
            s.Quality.AntiAliasing = temporal ? AntiAliasing.Temporal : AntiAliasing.Fxaa;
            Assert.Equal(ahead, PixelPostProcess.TemporalOutlineRuns(s));
            s.Pixelated = true;   // Pixelated refuses temporal anti-aliasing, so the chain keeps the outline
            Assert.False(PixelPostProcess.TemporalOutlineRuns(s));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TheSceneBuildsThePassOnlyWhenItRuns()
        {
            using var rig = new HeadlessSceneRig();
            rig.Scene.Post.Outline = true;
            rig.Scene.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = AntiAliasing.Fxaa;
            rig.Frame(96, 64);
            rig.Frame(96, 64);
            Assert.False(rig.Scene.TemporalOutlineBuiltForTests);

            rig.Scene.Post.Quality.AntiAliasing = AntiAliasing.Temporal;
            rig.Frame(96, 64);
            Assert.True(rig.Scene.TemporalOutlineBuiltForTests);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using KhaozEngine.Primitives;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace KhaozEngine.Tests.Gpu
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The toon edge outline under temporal anti-aliasing (task F16b). It runs ahead of the resolve, so under a still
    /// camera it converges to steady pixels instead of lines that move with the jitter, it lies where the FXAA frame
    /// draws it, and the frame stays upright. The outline is green, a hue nothing else in the frame has.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TemporalOutlineGpuTests
    {
        const int W = 320, H = 180, Warm = 16, Measured = 16;

        // Acceptance thresholds, first estimates the first real-Metal run retunes in one place.
        const int MinBoxPixels = 100;            // the blue box has to cover at least this many pixels
        const int MinChainOutlinePixels = 100;   // FXAA's own outline has to be visible at all
        const double MinOutlineShare = 0.5;      // resolved and shared outline pixels, as a share of FXAA's
        const double MaxStillFlipRate = 0.002;   // flips per pixel per frame for a converged still outline
        const int UprightRowMargin = 20;         // rows below the middle the low blue box sits when upright

        readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;
        public TemporalOutlineGpuTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

        static void Setup(FrontStage stage, Scene3D s, AntiAliasing aa)
        {
            stage.Setup(s, aa, TemporalUpscale.Native, sharpness: 0f);
            s.Post.Outline = true;   // after FrontStage's UseSmoothPreset, which turns it off
            s.Post.OutlineColor = new Color(0f, 1f, 0f, 1f);
        }

        // A tall box left of centre and a flat one low on the right, both turned so their silhouettes cross pixels at
        // an angle, on the grey wall.
        static void Draw(FrontStage stage, Scene3D s)
        {
            stage.Wall(s);
            s.Draw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(1.1f, 2.4f, 1f) * Matrix4x4.CreateRotationZ(0.3f)
                * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(-1.4f, 0.2f, 0f), new Color(0.85f, 0.55f, 0.35f, 1f));
            s.Draw(stage.Box, Matrix4x4.CreateScale(2.2f, 0.7f, 1f) * Matrix4x4.CreateRotationZ(-0.2f)
                * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(1.6f, -0.9f, 0f), new Color(0.35f, 0.45f, 0.85f, 1f));
        }

        static bool IsOutline(byte[] p, int i) => p[i + 1] > p[i] + 60 && p[i + 1] > p[i + 2] + 60;

        static int CountOutline(byte[] rgba)
        {
            int n = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < rgba.Length; i += 4) if (IsOutline(rgba, i)) n++;
            return n;
        }

        // The mean row of the blue box's pixels: below the middle when the frame is upright.
        static double BlueRow(byte[] rgba)
        {
            double sum = 0;
            int n = 0;
            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                {
                    int i = (y * W + x) * 4;
                    if (rgba[i + 2] > rgba[i] + 60 && rgba[i + 2] > rgba[i + 1] + 30) { sum += y; n++; }
                }
            Assert.True(n > MinBoxPixels, $"the blue box covered only {n} pixels");
            return sum / n;
        }

        [GpuFact]
        public void UnderTemporalAntiAliasingAStillOutlineConvergesToSteadyPixels()
        {
            var stage = new FrontStage(W, H, 4.5f);
            var region = new PixelRect(4, 4, W - 4, H - 4);
            var flips = new FlipCounter(W, H, region);
            byte[] last = Array.Empty<byte>();
            using (var fx = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => Setup(stage, s, AntiAliasing.Temporal)))
            {
                fx.Frames(Warm, (s, _) => Draw(stage, s));
                for (int i = 0; i < Measured; i++)
                {
                    last = fx.Frame((s, _) => Draw(stage, s));
                    flips.Add(last);
                }
                Assert.True(fx.Scene.TemporalOutlineBuiltForTests, "temporal anti-aliasing with the outline on must build the pass");
            }

            byte[] fxaa;
            using (var plain = new TemporalFixture(W, H, s => Setup(stage, s, AntiAliasing.Fxaa)))
            {
                fxaa = plain.Frame((s, _) => Draw(stage, s));
                Assert.False(plain.Scene.TemporalOutlineBuiltForTests, "FXAA must run the chain's own outline and build nothing");
            }

            int resolved = CountOutline(last), chain = CountOutline(fxaa), both = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < last.Length; i += 4) if (IsOutline(last, i) && IsOutline(fxaa, i)) both++;
            double rate = flips.FlipsPerPixelPerFrame;
            _out.WriteLine($"outline under temporal anti-aliasing, still camera: {rate:0.00000} flips per pixel per frame "
                + $"over {Measured} frames, {resolved} outline pixels against FXAA's {chain}, {both} shared");
            Assert.True(chain > MinChainOutlinePixels, $"the FXAA frame drew only {chain} outline pixels");
            Assert.True(resolved >= chain * MinOutlineShare, $"the resolved outline must stay visible: {resolved} pixels against FXAA's {chain}");
            Assert.True(both >= chain * MinOutlineShare, $"the resolved outline must lie where FXAA's does: {both} of {chain} shared");
            Assert.True(rate <= MaxStillFlipRate, $"a still outline must converge: {rate:0.00000} flips per pixel per frame");
            Assert.True(BlueRow(last) > H / 2 + UprightRowMargin, $"the frame must stay upright: the low blue box sits at row {BlueRow(last):0.0}");
        }
    }
}
```

`KhaozEngine.Render3D/Internal/ShaderSources.TemporalEdge.cs`:

```csharp
using System;

namespace KhaozEngine.Render3D.Internal
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The edge outline the temporal resolve reads (1 of the renderer's shader sources). Part of the
    /// <see cref="ShaderSources"/> partial: see ShaderSources.cs for the shared contract.
    /// </summary>
    internal static partial class ShaderSources
    {
        // ---- The toon edge outline for the pass PixelPostProcess runs ahead of the temporal resolve (task F16b). It is
        //      EdgeFrag with two lines changed, spliced here so the edge test cannot drift from the chain's. The UV comes
        //      from gl_FragCoord (upper-left on every backend) times Texel.xy, one over the internal size, so the
        //      outlined image keeps ColorTex's orientation, which the resolve reads by texelFetch, and the normal and
        //      depth are read at the same UV with no parity flip. The interpolant stays live at a 1e-30 weight, which
        //      changes no output, so the Direct3D 11 pixel-input signature keeps the TEXCOORD0 then SV_Position shape
        //      PaletteFrag ships. The splice throws at type initialisation if EdgeFrag stops holding either line once. ----
        public static readonly string TemporalEdgeFrag = TemporalEdgeSplice(TemporalEdgeSplice(EdgeFrag,
            "layout(location=0) in vec2 vUv;",
            "layout(location=0) in vec2 vUvIn;"),
            "    vec2 nuv = (Fade.z > 0.5) ? vec2(vUv.x, 1.0 - vUv.y) : vUv;",
            "    vec2 vUv = gl_FragCoord.xy * Texel.xy + vUvIn * 1.0e-30;   // upright: this pixel's centre, internal UV\n"
            + "    vec2 nuv = vUv;");

        static string TemporalEdgeSplice(string source, string oldText, string newText)
        {
            int at = source.IndexOf(oldText, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (at < 0 || source.IndexOf(oldText, at + oldText.Length, StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"EdgeFrag must hold \"{oldText}\" exactly once for TemporalEdgeFrag.");
            return string.Concat(source.AsSpan(0, at), newText, source.AsSpan(at + oldText.Length));
        }
    }
}
```

`KhaozEngine.Render3D/Rendering/PixelPostProcess.TemporalOutline.cs`:

```csharp
using KhaozEngine.Gpu;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D.Internal;

namespace KhaozEngine.Render3D.Rendering
{
    /// <summary>
    /// THE EDGE OUTLINE AHEAD OF THE TEMPORAL RESOLVE (task F16b). Under <see cref="AntiAliasing.Temporal"/> the post
    /// chain runs at display resolution after the resolve, where the edge pass would read the jittered internal normal
    /// and depth and its one-pixel lines would move with the jitter. So under temporal anti-aliasing the outline runs
    /// here instead, on the internal lit colour and on the opaque-only copy, before the resolve reads them, and the chain
    /// skips it. <see cref="ShaderSources.TemporalEdgeFrag"/> addresses pixels by <c>gl_FragCoord</c>, so the outlined
    /// images keep the orientation the resolve reads and no chain parity counts the pass. Every other mode runs the
    /// outline in the chain exactly as before, and nothing here is built.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed partial class PixelPostProcess
    {
        /// <summary>The draws <see cref="RunTemporalOutline"/> records: the lit colour and the opaque-only copy.</summary>
        internal const int TemporalOutlineDrawCalls = 2;

        IGpuPipeline? _temporalEdgePipe;
        GpuOutputDescription _temporalEdgeOutput;
        IGpuResourceSet? _temporalEdgeFromColor, _temporalEdgeFromOpaque;
        IGpuTexture? _temporalEdgeColor, _temporalEdgeOpaque;
        int _temporalEdgeGeneration = int.MinValue;

        /// <summary>Whether the outline runs ahead of the resolve this frame: it is on and the effective anti-aliasing
        /// mode is <see cref="AntiAliasingMode.Temporal"/>, which <see cref="PixelPostProcessSettings.Pixelated"/>
        /// refuses.</summary>
        internal static bool TemporalOutlineRuns(PixelPostProcessSettings s) =>
            s.Outline && s.EffectiveAaMode == AntiAliasingMode.Temporal;

        /// <summary>Whether the pass ahead of the resolve has been built. Internal, for the tests.</summary>
        internal bool TemporalOutlineBuilt => _temporalEdgePipe != null;

        /// <summary>
        /// Outline the internal lit colour into <c>res.PingA</c> and the opaque-only copy into <c>res.PingB</c>, the two
        /// images the resolve reads as its scene and opaque colour this frame. Reads the edge block
        /// <see cref="PrepareUniforms"/> uploaded this frame, whose texel size is the internal normal target's. Outlining
        /// both keeps the reactive estimate from reading the lines as transparent content, because the edge mask depends
        /// only on the normal and depth both images share. Call after every internal-resolution colour writer and
        /// before the resolve, outside any render pass the caller still needs.
        /// </summary>
        internal void RunTemporalOutline(IGpuCommandList cl, RenderResources res, IGpuTexture opaque)
        {
            IGpuResourceFactory f = _gd.Factory;
            GpuOutputDescription output = res.PingAFB.Outputs;
            if (_temporalEdgePipe is null || !SamePingFormat(output, _temporalEdgeOutput))
            {
                _temporalEdgePipe?.Dispose();
                _temporalEdgePipe = FullscreenPipeline(f, Pair(f, ShaderSources.TemporalEdgeFrag), _edgeLayout, output);
                _temporalEdgeOutput = output;
            }
            if (res.Generation != _temporalEdgeGeneration || !ReferenceEquals(res.ColorTex, _temporalEdgeColor)
                || !ReferenceEquals(opaque, _temporalEdgeOpaque))
            {
                DisposeTemporalOutlineSets();
                _temporalEdgeFromColor = f.CreateResourceSet(new GpuResourceSetDescription(_edgeLayout,
                    res.ColorTex, res.NormalTex, res.DepthColorTex, _gd.PointSampler, _edgeBuf));
                _temporalEdgeFromOpaque = f.CreateResourceSet(new GpuResourceSetDescription(_edgeLayout,
                    opaque, res.NormalTex, res.DepthColorTex, _gd.PointSampler, _edgeBuf));
                _temporalEdgeGeneration = res.Generation;
                _temporalEdgeColor = res.ColorTex;
                _temporalEdgeOpaque = opaque;
            }

            cl.SetFramebuffer(res.PingAFB);
            cl.SetPipeline(_temporalEdgePipe);
            cl.SetGraphicsResourceSet(0, _temporalEdgeFromColor!);
            cl.Draw(3);

            cl.SetFramebuffer(res.PingBFB);
            cl.SetPipeline(_temporalEdgePipe);
            cl.SetGraphicsResourceSet(0, _temporalEdgeFromOpaque!);
            cl.Draw(3);
        }

        // From Dispose. The shader set belongs to _shaderCache, which Dispose already empties.
        void DisposeTemporalOutline()
        {
            DisposeTemporalOutlineSets();
            _temporalEdgePipe?.Dispose();
            _temporalEdgePipe = null;
        }

        void DisposeTemporalOutlineSets()
        {
            _temporalEdgeFromColor?.Dispose();
            _temporalEdgeFromOpaque?.Dispose();
            _temporalEdgeFromColor = _temporalEdgeFromOpaque = null;
            _temporalEdgeColor = _temporalEdgeOpaque = null;
            _temporalEdgeGeneration = int.MinValue;
        }
    }
}
```
