```csharp
// tools/SnapshotTool/ShimmerMotion.cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Grimhollow.Core.Client;
using Grimhollow.Core.Config;
using KhaozEngine.Render3D;

namespace SnapshotTool;

/// <summary>How the camera moves through a measured run.</summary>
enum CameraMove
{
    /// <summary>Held still: the self-check, where the compensated metric must equal the raw one.</summary>
    Still,

    /// <summary>A slow orbit about the subject at <see cref="ShimmerMotion.PanRadiansPerSecond"/>.</summary>
    Pan,

    /// <summary>A slow push in towards the subject at <see cref="ShimmerMotion.DollyMetresPerSecond"/>.</summary>
    Dolly,
}

/// <summary>One path's start: the tile the orbit camera hangs off and its yaw and pitch, off the perf verb's path of
/// the same name.</summary>
sealed record MotionPath(string Name, Vector2 SubjectTile, float Yaw, float Pitch);

/// <summary>One measured cell: a path, a move and a zoom.</summary>
sealed record MotionCell(MotionPath Path, CameraMove Move, string Zoom, float Distance)
{
    public string Key => $"{Path.Name}-{Move.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()}-{Zoom}";

    /// <summary>The boom at a frame. Frame 0 is the first warmup frame, so the camera is already moving when the
    /// measured window opens. A dolly starts at the zoom's distance and only ever closes in.</summary>
    public (float Yaw, float Pitch, float Distance) At(int frame)
    {
        float t = frame * ShimmerShots.FrameSeconds;
        return Move switch
        {
            CameraMove.Pan => (Path.Yaw + (ShimmerMotion.PanRadiansPerSecond * t), Path.Pitch, Distance),
            CameraMove.Dolly => (Path.Yaw, Path.Pitch, Distance - (ShimmerMotion.DollyMetresPerSecond * t)),
            _ => (Path.Yaw, Path.Pitch, Distance),
        };
    }
}

/// <summary>A camera snapshot for one rendered frame, taken after the frame's boom is set.</summary>
readonly record struct CameraSnap(Matrix4x4 ViewProjection, Matrix4x4 Inverse, Vector3 Origin, Vector3 Eye)
{
    public static CameraSnap Of(FollowCamera3D camera)
    {
        Matrix4x4.Invert(camera.ViewProjection, out Matrix4x4 inverse);
        return new CameraSnap(camera.ViewProjection, inverse, camera.RenderOrigin, camera.Eye);
    }
}

/// <summary>What one configuration scored on one cell.</summary>
sealed record MotionRun(MotionCell Cell, ShimmerConfig Config, string ResolvedAa, (int W, int H) Internal,
    double RawFar, double RawAll, double CompensatedFar, double CompensatedAll, double GpuMedianMs, string Temporal);

/// <summary>What one configuration cost over the timed cells.</summary>
readonly record struct MotionCost(double GpuMedianMs, (int W, int H) Internal);

/// <summary>The shimmer verb's flip metric on camera-compensated steps.</summary>
/// <remarks>Each pixel's step is its luma now against last frame's luma, sampled bilinearly, where last frame's camera
/// saw the same ground point. The point comes from this frame's distance march, so a still scene under a moving
/// camera steps only where it is unstable. Props, trees and bodies are not in the heightfield, so a pixel over one is
/// reprojected as the ground behind it, the band rule the still probe already carries. A pixel with no ground hit,
/// or whose ground was off screen or behind last frame's camera, is not scored that frame.</remarks>
sealed class CompensatedFlicker
{
    readonly int _width, _height;
    readonly float[] _previous;
    readonly float[] _current;
    readonly sbyte[] _sign;
    readonly long[] _pixelFrames = new long[ShimmerBands.Count];
    readonly long[] _flips = new long[ShimmerBands.Count];
    CameraSnap _before;
    bool _primed;

    public CompensatedFlicker(int width, int height)
    {
        _width = width;
        _height = height;
        _previous = new float[width * height];
        _current = new float[width * height];
        _sign = new sbyte[width * height];
    }

    /// <summary>Scores one frame against the one before it, then keeps it for the next.</summary>
    public void Add(byte[] rgba, ShimmerDepth depth, in CameraSnap camera)
    {
        for (int p = 0; p < _current.Length; p++) _current[p] = FlickerAccumulator.Luma(rgba, p);
        if (_primed) Score(depth, camera);
        Array.Copy(_current, _previous, _current.Length);
        _before = camera;
        _primed = true;
    }

    /// <summary>Flips per scored pixel per second, over the far bands or over every ground band.</summary>
    public double FlipRate(bool far, float frameSeconds)
    {
        long flips = 0, pixels = 0;
        for (int b = 0; b < ShimmerBands.Sky; b++)
        {
            if (far && !ShimmerBands.IsFar(b)) continue;
            flips += _flips[b];
            pixels += _pixelFrames[b];
        }
        return pixels == 0 ? 0 : flips / (double)pixels / frameSeconds;
    }

    void Score(ShimmerDepth depth, CameraSnap now)
    {
        CameraSnap before = _before;
        object gate = new();
        Parallel.For(0, _height, () => new long[2 * ShimmerBands.Count], (y, _, local) =>
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
            {
                int p = (y * _width) + x;
                float metres = depth.Metres[p];
                if (!float.IsFinite(metres)) continue;
                Vector3 dir = ShimmerDepth.PixelRay(x + 0.5f, y + 0.5f, _width, _height, now.Inverse, now.Origin,
                    out _);
                Vector3 world = now.Eye + (dir * metres);
                Vector4 clip = Vector4.Transform(new Vector4(world - before.Origin, 1f), before.ViewProjection);
                if (clip.W <= 0f) continue;
                float sx = ((((clip.X / clip.W) + 1f) * 0.5f) * _width) - 0.5f;
                float sy = (((1f - (clip.Y / clip.W)) * 0.5f) * _height) - 0.5f;
                if (sx < -0.5f || sy < -0.5f || sx > _width - 0.5f || sy > _height - 0.5f) continue;
                sx = Math.Clamp(sx, 0f, _width - 1);
                sy = Math.Clamp(sy, 0f, _height - 1);
                int band = depth.Band[p];
                local[band]++;
                float delta = _current[p] - Bilinear(_previous, _width, _height, sx, sy);
                if (MathF.Abs(delta) <= FlickerAccumulator.Threshold) continue;
                sbyte sign = delta > 0f ? (sbyte)1 : (sbyte)-1;
                if (_sign[p] != 0 && _sign[p] != sign) local[ShimmerBands.Count + band]++;
                _sign[p] = sign;
            }
            return local;
        }, local =>
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                for (int b = 0; b < ShimmerBands.Count; b++)
                {
                    _pixelFrames[b] += local[b];
                    _flips[b] += local[ShimmerBands.Count + b];
                }
            }
        });
    }

    static float Bilinear(float[] luma, int width, int height, float x, float y)
    {
        int x0 = (int)x, y0 = (int)y;
        int x1 = Math.Min(x0 + 1, width - 1), y1 = Math.Min(y0 + 1, height - 1);
        float tx = x - x0, ty = y - y0;
        float top = luma[(y0 * width) + x0] + ((luma[(y0 * width) + x1] - luma[(y0 * width) + x0]) * tx);
        float bottom = luma[(y1 * width) + x0] + ((luma[(y1 * width) + x1] - luma[(y1 * width) + x0]) * tx);
        return top + ((bottom - top) * ty);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// The <c>shimmer --moving</c> mode: the shimmer verb's flip metric under a moving player camera, for FXAA, MSAA 4x
/// and TAA at each render quality, on the perf verb's town, forest and meadow paths. Each run opens the shipped
/// viewer offscreen through <see cref="ShimmerSession"/>, applies the player's choice through the viewer as Settings
/// does, cuts the camera at the path start and renders a slow pan or dolly at max and default zoom.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>The default rule reads <see cref="CompensatedFlicker"/>'s far band. The raw still-probe metric is kept
/// beside it in every table. The cost pass times each configuration on the pan cells with no read back, forward then
/// reversed, four rounds.</remarks>
static class ShimmerMotion
{
    public const string Flag = "--moving";
    public const float PanRadiansPerSecond = 0.1f;
    public const float DollyMetresPerSecond = 0.5f;
    const int TimingWarmup = 60;
    const int TimingRounds = 4;
    const double SelfCheckTolerance = 0.01;

    static readonly string[] PathNames = ["town", "forest", "meadow"];
    static readonly (string Name, float Distance)[] Zooms =
        [("max", PlayerRig.MaxDistance), ("default", PlayerRig.StartDistance)];
    static readonly string[] TaaKeys =
        ["taa-native", "taa-quality", "taa-balanced", "taa-performance", "taa-ultraperformance"];

    static readonly (string Key, string Label, GrimhollowAntiAliasing Choice, GrimhollowRenderQuality Quality)[]
        Choices =
    [
        ("fxaa", "FXAA at FixedInternal 1600x900", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Fxaa, GrimhollowRenderQuality.Native),
        ("msaa4", "MSAA 4x then FXAA at FixedInternal 1600x900", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Msaa4,
            GrimhollowRenderQuality.Native),
        ("taa-native", "TAA Native", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Taa, GrimhollowRenderQuality.Native),
        ("taa-quality", "TAA Quality", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Taa, GrimhollowRenderQuality.Quality),
        ("taa-balanced", "TAA Balanced", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Taa, GrimhollowRenderQuality.Balanced),
        ("taa-performance", "TAA Performance", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Taa, GrimhollowRenderQuality.Performance),
        ("taa-ultraperformance", "TAA Ultra Performance", GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Taa,
            GrimhollowRenderQuality.UltraPerformance),
    ];

    static string Px(float value) => value.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    static ShimmerConfig Config(string key, string label, GrimhollowAntiAliasing choice,
        GrimhollowRenderQuality quality, float? fade) => new(key, label, r =>
        {
            r.Viewer.RenderQuality = quality;
            r.Viewer.AntiAliasing = choice;
            if (fade is { } px) r.GroundCover.WindFadeBladePixels = px;
        }, false);

    static IEnumerable<ShimmerConfig> ConfigsFor(string[]? keys, float[]? taaFades)
    {
        foreach ((string key, string label, GrimhollowAntiAliasing choice, GrimhollowRenderQuality quality) in Choices)
        {
            if (keys is not null && Array.IndexOf(keys, key) < 0) continue;
            if (taaFades is null || choice != GrimhollowAntiAliasing.Taa)
            {
                yield return Config(key, label, choice, quality, null);
                continue;
            }
            foreach (float px in taaFades)
                yield return Config($"{key}-fade{Px(px)}", $"{label}, WindFadeBladePixels {Px(px)}", choice, quality,
                    px);
        }
    }

    static MotionPath PathFor(string name)
    {
        PerfPath perf = PerfPaths.All(default).Single(p => p.Name == name);
        PerfBoom boom = perf.Boom(0f);
        return new MotionPath(name, new Vector2(perf.Route[0].X + 0.5f, perf.Route[0].Z + 0.5f), boom.Yaw,
            boom.Pitch);
    }

    static IEnumerable<MotionCell> Cells(string[]? paths, string[] moves, string[]? zooms)
    {
        foreach (string name in PathNames)
        {
            if (paths is not null && Array.IndexOf(paths, name) < 0) continue;
            MotionPath path = PathFor(name);
            foreach (string move in moves)
            {
                CameraMove kind = Enum.Parse<CameraMove>(move, ignoreCase: true);
                foreach ((string zoom, float distance) in Zooms)
                    if (zooms is null || Array.IndexOf(zooms, zoom) >= 0)
                        yield return new MotionCell(path, kind, zoom, distance);
            }
        }
    }

    public static int Run(string[] args)
    {
        string? outDir = null;
        string[]? pathFilter = null, zoomFilter = null, configFilter = null;
        string[] moves = ["pan", "dolly"];
        float[]? taaFades = null;
        int width = 2560, height = 1440, frames = 120, warmup = 90, timingFrames = 240;
        bool selfCheck = false, costOnly = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
        {
            switch (args[i])
            {
                case "--paths": pathFilter = args[++i].Split(','); break;
                case "--moves": moves = args[++i].Split(','); break;
                case "--zooms": zoomFilter = args[++i].Split(','); break;
                case "--configs": configFilter = args[++i].Split(','); break;
                case "--taa-fades":
                    taaFades = args[++i].Split(',').Select(s => float.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                        .ToArray();
                    break;
                case "--frames": frames = int.Parse(args[++i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture); break;
                case "--warmup": warmup = int.Parse(args[++i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture); break;
                case "--timing-frames": timingFrames = int.Parse(args[++i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture); break;
                case "--self-check": selfCheck = true; break;
                case "--cost-only": costOnly = true; break;
                case "--res":
                    string[] wh = args[++i].Split('x');
                    (width, height) = (int.Parse(wh[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        int.Parse(wh[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                    break;
                default:
                    if (args[i].StartsWith("--", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                        throw new ArgumentException($"shimmer {Flag}: unknown option {args[i]}");
                    outDir = args[i];
                    break;
            }
        }
        if (selfCheck) return SelfCheck(width, height, warmup, frames);

        string dir = Path.GetFullPath(outDir ?? Path.Combine("tools", "SnapshotTool", "perf-results", "taa-motion"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        MotionCell[] cells = Cells(pathFilter, moves, zoomFilter).ToArray();
        ShimmerConfig[] configs = ConfigsFor(configFilter, taaFades).ToArray();
        if (cells.Length == 0 || configs.Length == 0) throw new ArgumentException($"shimmer {Flag}: nothing selected");

        var runs = new List<MotionRun>();
        if (!costOnly)
        {
            foreach (MotionCell cell in cells)
                foreach (ShimmerConfig config in configs)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"shimmer: {cell.Key} {config.Key}, {warmup} warmup + {frames} frames at "
                        + $"{width}x{height}");
                    MotionRun run = RunCell(cell, config, width, height, warmup, frames);
                    Console.WriteLine($"shimmer:   {run.ResolvedAa} internal {run.Internal.W}x{run.Internal.H}, far "
                        + $"flips/px/s compensated {run.CompensatedFar:F4} raw {run.RawFar:F4}, GPU median "
                        + $"{run.GpuMedianMs:F2} ms");
                    runs.Add(run);
                }
        }

        MotionCell[] timed = cells.Where(c => c.Move == CameraMove.Pan).ToArray();
        Dictionary<string, MotionCost> cost = timingFrames > 0 && timed.Length > 0
            ? Cost(timed, configs, width, height, timingFrames)
            : configs.ToDictionary(c => c.Key, c => new MotionCost(
                ShimmerShots.Median(runs.Where(r => r.Config.Key == c.Key).Select(r => r.GpuMedianMs).ToList()),
                runs.First(r => r.Config.Key == c.Key).Internal));
        string decision = costOnly ? "Cost only. No flicker was measured, so there is no decision."
            : taaFades is null ? DecideDefault(runs, cost) : DecideFade(runs, taaFades);

        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "summary.md"),
            Summary(runs, cost, configs, decision, width, height, warmup, frames, timingFrames, args));
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "ledger-table.md"), LedgerTable(runs, cost, configs, width, height));
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "decision.md"), decision + "\n");
        File.WriteAllLines(Path.Combine(dir, "metrics.csv"), Csv(runs));
        Console.WriteLine($"shimmer: {decision.Split('\n')[0]}");
        Console.WriteLine($"shimmer: done -> {dir}");
        return 0;
    }

    static ShimmerView View(MotionCell cell) =>
        new(cell.Key, cell.Key, cell.Path.SubjectTile, cell.Path.Yaw, cell.Path.Pitch, cell.Distance);

    static MotionRun RunCell(MotionCell cell, ShimmerConfig config, int width, int height, int warmup, int measured)
    {
        using var session = new ShimmerSession(View(cell), config, width, height);
        // The path starts on a cut, as a teleport does in play, so no configuration inherits a history.
        session.Scene.CameraCut();
        FlickerAccumulator? raw = null;
        var compensated = new CompensatedFlicker(width, height);
        ShimmerHeights? heights = null;
        var gpuMs = new List<double>(measured);
        string temporal = "";
        for (int i = 0; i < warmup + measured; i++)
        {
            (float yaw, float pitch, float distance) = cell.At(i);
            double waitMs = session.FrameAt(i, ShimmerShots.FrameSeconds, cell.Path.SubjectTile, yaw, pitch, distance);
            if (i < warmup) continue;
            gpuMs.Add(waitMs);
            byte[] rgba = session.ReadBack();
            heights ??= ShimmerHeights.Sample(session.Camera.Target, session.Viewer.Ground,
                session.Viewer.Document.TileSize);
            ShimmerDepth depth = ShimmerDepth.March(session.Camera, heights, width, height);
            raw ??= new FlickerAccumulator(width, height, depth.Band);
            raw.Add(rgba);
            compensated.Add(rgba, depth, CameraSnap.Of(session.Camera));
            if (i == warmup) temporal = session.Scene.LastTemporalDiagnostics.ToString();
        }
        FlickerStats stats = raw!.Stats(ShimmerShots.FrameSeconds);
        return new MotionRun(cell, config, session.ResolvedAa, InternalOf(session), stats.FlipRate(stats.Far),
            stats.FlipRate(stats.All), compensated.FlipRate(far: true, ShimmerShots.FrameSeconds),
            compensated.FlipRate(far: false, ShimmerShots.FrameSeconds), ShimmerShots.Median(gpuMs), temporal);
    }

    // The engine's own sizing rule by reflection, as the still probe reads it. A release that reshaped it reads as
    // 0x0 here, and the temporal diagnostics line still names the size TAA used.
    static (int W, int H) InternalOf(ShimmerSession session)
    {
        try
        {
            return session.InternalSize;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is InvalidOperationException or TargetParameterCountException
            or TargetInvocationException or ArgumentException or InvalidCastException)
        {
            return (0, 0);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The compensated metric's own proof. Over a still camera the reprojection is the identity, so its far
    /// flip rate has to match the raw metric's to within <see cref="SelfCheckTolerance"/>.</summary>
    static int SelfCheck(int width, int height, int warmup, int frames)
    {
        var cell = new MotionCell(PathFor("meadow"), CameraMove.Still, "max", PlayerRig.MaxDistance);
        MotionRun run = RunCell(cell, ConfigsFor(["fxaa"], null).Single(), width, height, warmup, frames);
        double gap = Math.Abs(run.CompensatedFar - run.RawFar) / Math.Max(run.RawFar, 1e-9);
        Console.WriteLine($"shimmer: self-check far raw {run.RawFar:F4} compensated {run.CompensatedFar:F4}, "
            + $"gap {gap:P2}, {(gap <= SelfCheckTolerance ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}");
        return gap <= SelfCheckTolerance ? 0 : 1;
    }

    static Dictionary<string, MotionCost> Cost(MotionCell[] cells, ShimmerConfig[] configs, int width, int height,
        int frames)
    {
        var medians = configs.ToDictionary(c => c.Key, _ => new List<double>());
        var sizes = new Dictionary<string, (int W, int H)>();
        foreach (MotionCell cell in cells)
            for (int round = 0; round < TimingRounds; round++)
                foreach (ShimmerConfig config in round % 2 == 0 ? configs : configs.AsEnumerable().Reverse())
                {
                    (List<double> ms, (int W, int H) size) = TimeCell(cell, config, width, height, frames);
                    double median = ShimmerShots.Median(ms);
                    medians[config.Key].Add(median);
                    sizes[config.Key] = size;
                    Console.WriteLine($"shimmer: cost {cell.Key} {config.Key} round {round + 1}: median {median:F2} ms");
                }
        return medians.ToDictionary(p => p.Key, p => new MotionCost(ShimmerShots.Median(p.Value), sizes[p.Key]));
    }

    static (List<double> Ms, (int W, int H) Internal) TimeCell(MotionCell cell, ShimmerConfig config, int width,
        int height, int frames)
    {
        using var session = new ShimmerSession(View(cell), config, width, height);
        session.Scene.CameraCut();
        var ms = new List<double>(frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < TimingWarmup + frames; i++)
        {
            (float yaw, float pitch, float distance) = cell.At(i);
            double wait = session.FrameAt(i, ShimmerShots.FrameSeconds, cell.Path.SubjectTile, yaw, pitch, distance);
            if (i >= TimingWarmup) ms.Add(wait);
        }
        return (ms, InternalOf(session));
    }

    static string[] MovingCells(List<MotionRun> runs) =>
        runs.Where(r => r.Cell.Move != CameraMove.Still).Select(r => r.Cell.Key).Distinct().ToArray();

    static double Far(List<MotionRun> runs, string cell, string config) =>
        runs.Single(r => r.Cell.Key == cell && r.Config.Key == config).CompensatedFar;

    /// <summary>The spec's rule: the cheapest TAA render quality whose compensated far flip rate is under MSAA 4x's in
    /// every moving cell. None passing keeps MSAA 4x.</summary>
    static string DecideDefault(List<MotionRun> runs, Dictionary<string, MotionCost> cost)
    {
        string[] cells = MovingCells(runs);
        var lines = new StringBuilder();
        string? pick = null;
        foreach (string key in TaaKeys.Where(cost.ContainsKey).OrderBy(k => cost[k].GpuMedianMs))
        {
            int wins = cells.Count(cell => Far(runs, cell, key) < Far(runs, cell, "msaa4"));
            lines.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                $"- `{key}`: {cost[key].GpuMedianMs:F2} ms, under `msaa4` in {wins} of {cells.Length} cells");
            if (pick is null && wins == cells.Length) pick = key;
        }
        string head = pick is null
            ? "Default: msaa4. No TAA render quality beat MSAA 4x on compensated far flips in every cell."
            : $"Default: {pick}. The cheapest TAA render quality under MSAA 4x's compensated far flips in every cell.";
        return head + "\n\n" + lines.ToString().TrimEnd();
    }

    /// <summary>The TAA wind fade rule: the smallest fade at which every TAA configuration in the run stays under
    /// MSAA 4x's compensated far flips in every cell, which keeps the most sway. None passing keeps the shipped
    /// fade.</summary>
    static string DecideFade(List<MotionRun> runs, float[] fades)
    {
        string[] cells = MovingCells(runs);
        foreach (float px in fades.Order())
        {
            string suffix = $"-fade{Px(px)}";
            string[] keys = runs.Select(r => r.Config.Key).Where(k => k.EndsWith(suffix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .Distinct().ToArray();
            if (keys.Length > 0 && keys.All(k => cells.All(cell => Far(runs, cell, k) < Far(runs, cell, "msaa4"))))
                return $"TAA fade: {Px(px)}. The smallest swept value that stays under MSAA 4x in every cell.";
        }
        return "TAA fade: none. No swept value stayed under MSAA 4x in every cell, so the shipped fade stays.";
    }

    static string Summary(List<MotionRun> runs, Dictionary<string, MotionCost> cost, ShimmerConfig[] configs,
        string decision, int width, int height, int warmup, int frames, int timingFrames, string[] args)
    {
        var md = new StringBuilder();
        md.AppendLine("# Shimmer under a moving camera");
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"`shimmer {Flag}` at {width}x{height} output, {warmup} warmup "
            + $"and {frames} measured frames at 60 Hz on native Metal, cost over {timingFrames} frames on the pan "
            + $"cells. Pan {PanRadiansPerSecond} rad/s about the subject, dolly {DollyMetresPerSecond} m/s towards it. "
            + $"Every run opens on `Scene3D.CameraCut`. Far is ground 30 m or more from the camera.");
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("Arguments: `" + string.Join(' ', args) + "`");
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine(decision);
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("| Cell | Config | Resolved | Internal | Far compensated | All compensated | Far raw | All raw "
            + "| GPU median ms |");
        md.AppendLine("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |");
        foreach (MotionRun r in runs)
            md.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"| {r.Cell.Key} | {r.Config.Key} | {r.ResolvedAa} | "
                + $"{r.Internal.W}x{r.Internal.H} | {r.CompensatedFar:F4} | {r.CompensatedAll:F4} | {r.RawFar:F4} | "
                + $"{r.RawAll:F4} | {r.GpuMedianMs:F2} |");
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("## Cost on the pan cells, no read back");
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("| Config | Internal | GPU median ms |");
        CostRows(md, cost, configs);
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("## Temporal diagnostics at the first measured frame");
        md.AppendLine();
        foreach (MotionRun r in runs.Where(r => r.Config.Key.StartsWith("taa", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            md.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"- {r.Cell.Key} {r.Config.Key}: {r.Temporal}");
        return md.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>The two tables the ledger entry pastes as they stand.</summary>
    static string LedgerTable(List<MotionRun> runs, Dictionary<string, MotionCost> cost, ShimmerConfig[] configs,
        int width, int height)
    {
        var md = new StringBuilder();
        if (runs.Count > 0)
        {
            md.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"Far flips per pixel per second, camera compensated, at "
                + $"{width}x{height} output. Lower is steadier.");
            md.AppendLine();
            md.Append("| Path | Move | Zoom |");
            foreach (ShimmerConfig c in configs) md.Append(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $" {c.Label} |");
            md.AppendLine();
            md.Append("| --- | --- | --- |");
            foreach (ShimmerConfig _ in configs) md.Append(" --- |");
            md.AppendLine();
            foreach (MotionCell cell in runs.Select(r => r.Cell).DistinctBy(c => c.Key))
            {
                md.Append(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                    $"| {cell.Path.Name} | {cell.Move.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()} | {cell.Zoom} |");
                foreach (ShimmerConfig c in configs)
                    md.Append(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $" {Far(runs, cell.Key, c.Key):F3} |");
                md.AppendLine();
            }
            md.AppendLine();
        }
        md.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"| Config | Internal at {width}x{height} | GPU median ms, pan cells |");
        CostRows(md, cost, configs);
        return md.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>The cost table's separator and one row per configuration, shared by the summary and the ledger
    /// table so the two never drift apart.</summary>
    static void CostRows(StringBuilder md, Dictionary<string, MotionCost> cost, ShimmerConfig[] configs)
    {
        md.AppendLine("| --- | --- | --- |");
        foreach (ShimmerConfig c in configs)
            md.AppendLine(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                $"| {c.Label} | {cost[c.Key].Internal.W}x{cost[c.Key].Internal.H} | {cost[c.Key].GpuMedianMs:F2} |");
    }

    static IEnumerable<string> Csv(List<MotionRun> runs)
    {
        yield return "cell,path,move,zoom,config,resolved,internal_w,internal_h,far_compensated,all_compensated,"
            + "far_raw,all_raw,gpu_median_ms";
        foreach (MotionRun r in runs)
            yield return string.Join(',', r.Cell.Key, r.Cell.Path.Name, r.Cell.Move.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(),
                r.Cell.Zoom, r.Config.Key, r.ResolvedAa.Replace(',', ' '),
                r.Internal.W.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), r.Internal.H.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                r.CompensatedFar.ToString("F5", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                r.CompensatedAll.ToString("F5", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                r.RawFar.ToString("F5", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), r.RawAll.ToString("F5", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                r.GpuMedianMs.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
    }
}
```

```markdown
#### What the adoption wired

- **Motion keys.** `BodyMotion` keys every moving body from its replicated net id, which the server hands out from
  one counter that starts at 1 and never reuses an id. Each piece takes `MotionKey.Combine(body, slot)` and each mesh
  part inside it `Combine(piece, part)`. The local player, every remote player and monster, their held pieces and
  the wrist wrap, and a carcass under its own id all draw through `ITileWorldScene.DrawMesh(in RigidInstanceDraw)`.
  A carcass is keyed because its collapse moves for `CarcassPresentation.CollapseSeconds`, 0.9 s, which amends the
  resolve spec's static list. Ground drops, placed props, doorways, terrain and tile ground stay unkeyed, and the
  level-up sparks are particles.
- **Cuts.** A teleport and the F8 camera flip call `Scene3D.CameraCut`.
- **Settings.** `Anti-aliasing` offers `FXAA`, `MSAA 4x` and `TAA`. `Render quality` offers `Native`, `Quality`,
  `Balanced`, `Performance` and `Ultra Performance`, applies live, and is dimmed and inert unless `TAA` is chosen, so the shared row grid
  never moves. `GrimhollowAntiAliasingSettings` maps both and the grass wind fade. Still art captures render under
  `MSAA 4x` when the default is `TAA`, because two capture frames build no history.
```

`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:392`: change `shadow detail, anti-aliasing),` to `shadow detail, anti-aliasing, render quality),`
and keep the rest of the line. Replace lines 414-420 with:

```markdown
`Anti-aliasing` offers FXAA, MSAA 4x and TAA. TAA at `Balanced` render quality is the default. FXAA and MSAA 4x
render at the fixed 1600x900 internal size, and MSAA 4x is four-sample MSAA with FXAA after the resolve. TAA is the
engine's temporal anti-aliasing with upscaling. It jitters each frame, keeps a history and rebuilds the image at the
window's own size from a smaller internal render, which holds distant grass steady while the camera moves.
`Render quality` sets that internal size: Native (the window), Quality (two thirds on each axis), Balanced (about 59
percent), Performance (half) and Ultra Performance (a third, for very dense displays). It applies only while TAA is
selected and is dimmed and inert otherwise, keeping
its saved value. Both rows are saved first and applied to the running scene at once, and the viewer seeds them when
the world opens. The anti-aliasing choice also sets the grass wind fade, the blade height in internal pixels under
which short cover and the authored grass props stop swaying: 1.5 under TAA, 3 under MSAA 4x and 6 under FXAA.
Moving bodies draw under motion keys from their net ids (`BodyMotion`), and a teleport or the F8 camera flip cuts the
temporal history. The still snapshot captures render under MSAA 4x when the default is TAA. `GrimhollowAntiAliasingSettings`
is the one mapping to the engine values, the preset and the fade.
```

## Appendix: the shared plan contract

The names, types and conventions every group was planned against. Each group's "Contract amendments" block records where the code changed a name or a detail, and those amendments win over this appendix.

### Specs

- `/Users/antonio/KhaozEngine/.worktrees/temporal-foundations/docs/design/TEMPORAL-FOUNDATIONS-DESIGN-2026-09-24.md` (round 1)
- `/Users/antonio/KhaozEngine/.worktrees/temporal-foundations/docs/design/TEMPORAL-RESOLVE-UPSCALING-DESIGN-2026-09-24.md` (rounds 2 and 3)

Engine repo: `/Users/antonio/KhaozEngine` (read code at the worktree above, branch `feature/temporal-foundations`, which is engine `main` plus the two specs). Grimhollow repo: `/Users/antonio/Grimhollow` (`main`).

### Engine conventions every task follows

- C# on .NET 10, xUnit. Warnings are errors. Every build and test command runs in Release.
- Engine tests live in `KhaozEngine.Render.Tests` under namespaces `KhaozEngine.Tests.*`. Unit tests beside the area (`KhaozEngine.Render.Tests/Render3D/...`), GPU tests in `KhaozEngine.Render.Tests/Gpu/...` with `[GpuFact]` or `[GpuTheory]`, run with `KE_GPU_TESTS=1` on the local native Metal device. A test that reads allocation joins the `AllocSensitive` collection.
- GLSL 450 shader sources live in `KhaozEngine.Render3D/Internal/ShaderSources*.cs`. A new or changed program updates: the three hash tables (rebake with `KE_UPDATE_MSL_HASHES=1`, `KE_UPDATE_SPIRV_HASHES=1`, `KE_UPDATE_HLSL_HASHES=1` on the matching `*ByteEquality` tests, never hand edited), rows in `KhaozEngine.Render.Tests/Gpu/ShippedShaderPrograms.cs`, and the seven hand-maintained lists in `VulkanShaderBindingTableTests.cs`, `VulkanDescriptorLimitTests.cs`, `D3D11ResourceModelTests.cs`, `D3D11RegisterNumberingTests.cs`, `ShaderSourceValidationTests.cs`, `Render3D/UboLayoutTests.cs` and `VulkanShippedVertexLayoutTests.cs`, plus the pinned counts in `ShippedShaderPrograms.cs`, `VulkanShaderBindingTableTests.cs`, `D3D11HlslByteEqualityTests.cs`, `VulkanSpirvByteEqualityTests.cs` (two stages per program), `VulkanDescriptorLimitTests.cs`, `VulkanDynamicOffsetTests.cs` (layouts) and `VulkanLayoutCompatibilityTests.cs` (pipelines, and pipelines squared). Name each one a task touches.
- `Scene3D.cs` is frozen by the file-size ratchet (`scripts/check-file-size.sh`, `.filesize-baseline`). New behaviour goes in new partials `Scene3D.<Feature>.cs` or new types. No baseline entry grows. The cap for new files is 800 lines.
- No em or en dash characters anywhere. No semicolons in Markdown prose or comment prose. Semicolons in code are fine.
- Commit subjects `area(scope): summary`, for example `render3d(temporal): latch one frame view per render`. Stage explicit paths. Never use `git stash`.
- With temporal inactive, every committed golden stays byte-identical on Metal, D3D11 and Vulkan, and no new target, pipeline or buffer is created. Every task that touches a raster path proves this with the full local Metal GPU suite.
- Implementers never push, merge, tag, bump the engine's `<KhaozEngineVersion>` or edit the engine's `CHANGELOG.md`. The orchestrator owns integration and release.

### Branches and worktrees

Each task group runs on its own branch cut from `feature/temporal-foundations` into `/Users/antonio/KhaozEngine/.worktrees/taa-<group>` (for example `feature/taa-frame-view` in `.worktrees/taa-frame-view`), with `mkdir -p local-feed` before the first build. Groups merge back into `feature/temporal-foundations` in order. The Grimhollow group runs in `/Users/antonio/Grimhollow/.worktrees/taa-adoption` on `feature/taa-adoption` cut from Grimhollow `main`, after the engine release.

### Names and types (the contract)

#### Round 1, frame view and jitter (group A)

```csharp
namespace KhaozEngine.Render3D.Internal;
internal readonly struct FrameView
{
    public Matrix4x4 View { get; }                    // unjittered, render-relative
    public Matrix4x4 Projection { get; }              // unjittered
    public Matrix4x4 ViewProjection { get; }          // unjittered, render-relative (View * Projection)
    public Matrix4x4 AbsoluteViewProjection { get; }  // unjittered, absolute, for CPU spatial work
    public Matrix4x4 JitteredProjection { get; }
    public Matrix4x4 JitteredViewProjection { get; }  // render-relative, what the rasteriser uses
    public Vector2 JitterPixels { get; }              // internal pixels, each in [-0.5, 0.5)
    public Vector2 JitterClip { get; }                // (2 * px / width, -2 * py / height)
    public Vector3 RenderOrigin { get; }
    public int Width { get; }
    public int Height { get; }
    public bool IsOrthographic { get; }
    public long FrameIndex { get; }
}
internal static class TemporalJitter
{
    public static int PhaseCount(float displayOverInternalRatio);        // 8 at 1.0, ceil(8 * r * r) above
    public static Vector2 Offset(long frameIndex, int phaseCount);       // Halton(2,3) minus 0.5
    public static Matrix4x4 Apply(in Matrix4x4 projection, Vector2 jitterPixels, int width, int height);
}
```

`Scene3D` latches `internal FrameView CurrentFrameView` right after `EnsureSize` in `RenderInternal` (in a new partial `Scene3D.FrameView.cs`). Raster consumers read `CurrentFrameView.JitteredViewProjection` (and the sky reads `View` plus `JitteredProjection`). CPU consumers read the unjittered fields. Jitter is `Vector2.Zero` unless `TemporalActive`.

#### Round 1, previous frame, history and settings (group B)

```csharp

{

}

    int KeyedRigid, int KeyedSkinned, int KeyCollisions, bool HistoryValid, TemporalResetReason LastReset);
    // round 2 (group F) appends: internal and display size, preset, disoccluded, reactive and clipped counts

// Scene3D members (new partials):
public void CameraCut();
```

`SceneInstances.Instance` gains a get-only `MotionKey Motion` property (CPU side, not uploaded). The existing overloads forward with `MotionKey.None`.

#### Round 1, motion target and per-path motion (group D)

- `RenderResources.MotionTex`, `GpuPixelFormat` RG16 float, internal size, created only while `TemporalActive`. A fourth attachment on `ModelFB` in temporal pipeline variants.
- Sentinel for background: both channels `65504` (half max). Consumers treat `abs(x) > 60000` as background.
- Motion encoding: `currentUv - previousUv`, where `uv = ndc.xy * (0.5, -0.5) + 0.5` from UNJITTERED clip positions.
- Rigid previous transforms: a per-frame buffer `PreviousInstanceTransforms` indexed by instance slot, read in the vertex stage, written only while temporal is active. Task D1 proves the GPU seam can bind a readable buffer to the vertex stage on Metal, D3D11 and Vulkan before anything depends on it. Fallback named in the spec.
- Test seam: `internal Scene3D.ReadMotionTargetForTests()` returning the RG16F target as `Half[]` or `Vector2[]` with width and height.
- Multi-frame GPU fixture: `KhaozEngine.Render.Tests/Gpu/TemporalFixture.cs` with a deterministic camera path and time per frame, reused by rounds 1 and 2.

History colour format: RGBA16F, and confidence and stability RG16F, as task E1 records (R11G11B10 is not a seam format, Vulkan does not guarantee it as a render target, and its mantissa stalls a 1/16 blend). Previous depth: two R32F linear view depth targets at the internal size. All owned by `TemporalHistory`.
